```{r kbo time-weighted SNV cluster df prep and metadata of genomes}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

### Load data

chinese_patient_metadata_v1 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/patient_metadata_v1.tsv")

italian_mdata <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/Italian/strain_pulsotypes.txt")

poppunk <- read_csv("PopPUNK/refinedbgmm_model_fit_k_3_clusters.csv")

PP_location_list <- read_tsv("PopPUNK/location_list_1227.txt", col_names = c("Genome", "Path"))

LINcodes <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/LINcode_chinese_italian.tsv")

Kleborate <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/Kleborate_chinese_italian.tsv")

patient_metadata_italy_v1 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/Italian_study/patient_metadata_italy_v1.txt")

SNV_clusters <- read_tsv("kbo/time_weighted_SNV_clusters.tsv")

AMRFinder_results <- read_tsv("AMRFinderPlus/combined_AMR_data.tsv")

mobtyper_results <- read_tsv("plasmids/combined_mobtyper_data.tsv")

virulence_alleles <- read_tsv("virulence_factors_alleles/virulence_alleles_combined.tsv")

### Manip dfs

# Merge relevant data together

chinese_patient_mdata_min <- chinese_patient_metadata_v1 |> 
  select(2, 7) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

italian_mdata_min <- italian_mdata |> 
  select(1, 5) |> 
  mutate(Date = dmy(Isolation_Date)) |> 
  select(-2) |> 
  rename(Infecting_isolate = Strain)

mdata_dates <- bind_rows(chinese_patient_mdata_min, italian_mdata_min)

# Generate kbo input
PP_location_list_kbo_input <- PP_location_list |> 
  left_join(poppunk, by = c("Genome" = "Taxon")) |> 
  left_join(mdata_dates, by = c("Genome" = "Infecting_isolate"))
# write_tsv(PP_location_list_kbo_input, "kbo/PP_location_list_kbo_input.txt", col_names = FALSE)

# Generate v1 of genomic metadata

# Strain mdata for Italy
strain_metadata_italy_min <- patient_metadata_italy_v1 |> 
  select(1, 40) |> 
  mutate(
    Specimen = str_remove(Specimen, " culture")
    )

strain_metadata_italy_v1 <- italian_mdata |> 
  select(1, 2, 3, 5) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(Isolation_Date)
  ) |> 
  select(-Isolation_Date) |> 
  mutate(WGS = ifelse(WGS == "Yes", "Yes", "No")) |> 
  rename(Infecting_isolate = Strain) |> 
  left_join(strain_metadata_italy_min, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  mutate(
    Dataset = "Italy",
    Specimen = "Blood"
    ) |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Date, Specimen, Pulsotype, WGS, Dataset)

# Strain mdata for China
strain_metadata_china_v1 <- chinese_patient_metadata_v1 |> 
  select(2, 7, 5) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) |> 
  mutate(
    Pulsotype = NA_character_,
    WGS = "Yes"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Dataset = "China")

# Wider AMR data for merging
AMR_prep_wide <- AMRFinder_results |> 
  select(1, 7, 8, 11) |> 
  rename(
    Element_symbol = "Element symbol",
    Element_name = "Element name"
    ) |> 
  mutate(generic_amr_gene = case_when(
    Subtype == "POINT" & str_detect(Element_symbol, "_") ~ str_replace(Element_symbol, "_.*$", "_point"),
    # str_detect(Element_symbol, "delta.*$") ~ str_remove(Element_symbol, "delta.*$"),
    # str_detect(Element_symbol, "delta$") ~ str_remove(Element_symbol, "delta"),
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "qacE") ~ "qacE",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aac\\(3") ~ "aac(3)",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aac\\(6") ~ "aac(6')",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "ant\\(2''") ~ "ant(2'')",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aph\\(3''") ~ "aph(3'')",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aph\\(3'") ~ "aph(3')",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aph\\(4") ~ "aph(4)",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "aph\\(6") ~ "aph(6)",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "mcr-") ~ "mcr",
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "fosA3") ~ "fosA3",
    # catch other more standard numeric alleles
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "-\\d+$") ~ str_remove(Element_symbol, "-\\d+$"),
    str_detect(Element_symbol, "\\d+$") ~ str_remove(Element_symbol, "\\d+$"),
    TRUE ~ Element_symbol
  )
  ) |> 
  mutate(amr_variant = case_when(
    Subtype == "POINT" & str_detect(Element_symbol, "_") ~ str_replace(Element_symbol, "^.*_", ""),
    TRUE ~ Element_symbol
  )
  ) |> 
  select(1, 2, 5, 6) |> 
  mutate(Presence = as.numeric(1))

# Get raw counts of generics, this may be helpful
count_generic_AMR_per_genome <- AMR_prep_wide |>
  group_by(Filename, generic_amr_gene) |> 
  summarise(total_generic_amr_genes_per_genome = n()) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "generic_amr_gene",
    values_from = "total_generic_amr_genes_per_genome",
    values_fill = 0
    ) |> 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_count"), 2:last_col())

# Pres/abs of AMR genes...
AMR_pres_wide <- AMR_prep_wide |>
  select(1, 2, 5) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Element_symbol", values_from = "Presence", values_fill = 0, values_fn = max) |> 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_presence"), 2:last_col())

# Merge together
AMR_wide <- count_generic_AMR_per_genome |> 
  left_join(AMR_pres_wide, by = "Filename")

# Count most abundant plasmids
plas_type_count <- mobtyper_results |> 
  group_by(`rep_type(s)`) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

# Plasmid data prep
mobtyper_wide <- mobtyper_results |> 
  select(1, 19, 20, 7) |> 
  group_by(Filename, primary_cluster_id) |> 
  summarise(n_per_genome = n()) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "primary_cluster_id", values_from = "n_per_genome", values_fill = 0, values_fn = max) |> 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_plasmid_presence"), 2:last_col())

# Virulence prep
virulence_wide <- virulence_alleles |> 
  select(2, 1, 15, 7, 11) |> 
  arrange(desc(Identity), desc(DNA_length)) |> 
  # Get top hit to prevent weird dupes - cos partials cause this issue, so simple fix is assume presence and take the best match. Could be multiple genes but not relevant at this stage, especially for draft assemblies
  group_by(Assembly, Reference) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-c(4:5)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Reference", values_from = "DNA_hash", values_fill = NA_character_) |>  # , values_fn = max
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_allele"), 2:last_col())

# finding dupes to remove
vir <- virulence_alleles |> 
  select(2, 1, 15, 7, 11) |> 
  arrange(desc(Identity), desc(DNA_length)) |> 
  # Get top hit to prevent weird dupes
  group_by(Assembly, Reference) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .by = c(Assembly, Reference)) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1L)

# Generate v2 genome mdata
genome_mdata_v2 <- bind_rows(strain_metadata_italy_v1, strain_metadata_china_v1) |> 
  left_join(poppunk, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Taxon")) |> 
  rename(PopPUNK_cluster = Cluster) |> 
  left_join(LINcodes, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Genome_Name")) |> 
  left_join(Kleborate, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Genome_Name")) |>
  left_join(SNV_clusters, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Genome", "PopPUNK_cluster" = "Cluster")) |> 
  mutate(Pulsotype = as.character(Pulsotype)) |>
  rename(Species = species) |> 
  relocate(Species, .after = Infecting_isolate) |> 
  relocate(PopPUNK_cluster, .after = Species) |> 
  relocate(Sublineage, .after = PopPUNK_cluster) |> 
  relocate(Pulsotype, .after = Sublineage) |> 
  relocate(time_weighted_SNV_cluster, .after = PopPUNK_cluster) |> 
  # Propagate LINcodes and PPs to same pulsotypes
  arrange(PopPUNK_cluster, Sublineage, Species) |> 
  group_by(Pulsotype) |> 
  fill(PopPUNK_cluster, .direction = "down") |> 
  fill(Sublineage, .direction = "down") |> 
  fill(Species, .direction = "down") |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(across(c(13:last_col()), ~ ifelse(. == "-", NA_character_, .))) |> 
  left_join(AMR_wide, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Filename")) |> 
  # Let's remove some unnecessary cols
  mutate_at(vars(15, 29, 47, 55, 62), ~ifelse(. == 0, NA_character_, .)) |> 
  mutate(
    K_locus_identity = (as.numeric(str_replace(K_locus_identity, "%", "")) / 100),
    O_locus_identity = (as.numeric(str_replace(O_locus_identity, "%", "")) / 100),
  ) |> 
  select(-c(46, 106, 108, 112)) |> 
  left_join(mobtyper_wide, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Filename")) |> 
  left_join(virulence_wide, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Assembly"))
write_tsv(genome_mdata_v2, "Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v2.tsv")

# Look at duplicate entries, as I should ahve 1177+50 = 1227. Oh, but no I only have 50 genomes but I have additional 112 WITHOUT WGS. But I propagated the relevant PopPUNK clusters to these, so even if I don't have the genome info, if there is sublineage signal, we will find it :)
dupe_genomes <- genome_mdata_v2 |> 
  group_by(Infecting_isolate) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |> 
  filter(count > 1) 

# Look at any missing PP clusters
missing_spp_PP <- genome_mdata_v2 |> 
  filter(is.na(PopPUNK_cluster) | is.na(Species))
# So there is an issue with B11 vs B1? May be a typo - follow up with Gianluca

```

```{r kmer merging for unitig analysis with muset and AMR data}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)


### Load data

genome_mdata_v2 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v2.tsv")

filenames_muset <- read_delim("unitig/muset/in_file_muset.txt", col_names = c("Genome", "bla", "blah"), delim = " ")
filename_list <- unlist(filenames_muset$Genome)

unitig_counts_muset <- read_tsv("unitig/muset/unitig_abundance.tsv", col_names = c("kmer_id", filename_list))

genome_seq_status <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_seq_status.tsv")

# Categorical cols
categorical_cols_list <- read_lines("ML_predictions/ML_matrices/input_v1_start/categorical_cols_list.txt")

# Combined AMR data
combined_AMR_data <- read_tsv("AMRFinderPlus/combined_AMR_data.tsv")

# write_tsv(unitig_counts_muset, "unitig/muset/unitig_counts_muset_headers.tsv")
# Now delete the unitig_abundance.tsv as its unncessary. Unitigs ready for ML input wrangling

# Remove Sex and Infection_aquisition as these are only present in the patient mdata
categorical_cols_list_bacterial <- categorical_cols_list[!categorical_cols_list %in% c("Sex", "Infection_aquisition")]

# Count the abundance across dataset of each unitig
unitig_sum_across_data <- unitig_counts_muset |> 
  mutate(
    n_unitig_positive_genomes = rowSums(across(-kmer_id, ~ .x > 0)),
    prop_unitig_positive_genomes = n_unitig_positive_genomes / 1227
    )

ggplot(unitig_sum_across_data, aes(x = prop_unitig_positive_genomes)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.001)

filtered_unitig_avg_abundance <- unitig_sum_across_data |> 
  filter(n_unitig_positive_genomes >= 5) |> 
  select(-c(n_unitig_positive_genomes, prop_unitig_positive_genomes))
# write_tsv(filtered_unitig_avg_abundance, "unitig/muset/filtered_unitig_avg_abundance.tsv")

# count_PPs <- genome_mdata_v2 |> 
#   group_by(PopPUNK_cluster) |>  # 
#   summarise(count = n())
# 200 SLs,317 PPs, 290 STs

# Transpose df for genome as rows for merging
t_filtered_unitig_avg_abundance <- filtered_unitig_avg_abundance |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -kmer_id,
    names_to = "genome",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |> 
  mutate(unitig = paste0("unitig_", kmer_id, "_avg_abundance")) %>%
  select(genome, unitig, abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = unitig,
    values_from = abundance
  )

genome_mdata_v3 <- genome_mdata_v2 |> 
  left_join(t_filtered_unitig_avg_abundance, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "genome")) |> 
  # Need to convert clone info to categorical not numeric...
  mutate(
    PopPUNK_cluster = str_replace(PopPUNK_cluster, "^", "PP_cluster_"),
    time_weighted_SNV_cluster = str_replace(time_weighted_SNV_cluster, "^", "SNV_cluster_"),
    Sublineage = str_replace(Sublineage, "^", "SL"),
  ) |> 
  # Remove stuff that is unnecessary for ML training
  select(-c(WGS, QC_warnings, Closest_cgST, LINcode, spurious_ybt_hits, spurious_abst_hits, spurious_smst_hits, spurious_rmst_hits, spurious_virulence_hits, Ciprofloxacin_profile_support, K_locus_confidence, K_locus_identity, O_locus_confidence, O_locus_identity, O_Missing_expected_genes)) |>
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) |> 
  # Fix up stuff that could appear as numeric but is categorical...
  mutate(
    across(c(11, 13:23, 24, 26:41, 43:48, 50:54, 56:58), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), NA, paste0(cur_column(), "_", .))
  ))
write_tsv(genome_mdata_v3, "Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v3.tsv")


# genome_mdata_v3 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v3.tsv")

# Get AMR counts
count_AMR_subclasses <- combined_AMR_data |> 
  group_by(Filename, Subclass) |> 
  summarise(number_subclass_resistances = n()) |> 
  rename(
    Infecting_isolate = Filename
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Subclass = str_to_sentence(Subclass),
    Subclass = str_replace(Subclass, " ", "_")
    )

# Get wide counts for ML matrix if I repeat...
AMR_subclass_counts_wide <- count_AMR_subclasses |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Subclass",
    values_from = "number_subclass_resistances",
    values_fill = 0,
    names_glue = "{Subclass}_resistance_counts_AMRFP"
    ) |> 
  rename_with( ~str_replace_all(., "/", "_"))
write_tsv(AMR_subclass_counts_wide, "AMRFinderPlus/AMR_subclass_counts_wide.tsv")


# Fix genome_metadata prior to merging before ML training
genome_mdata_v4 <- genome_mdata_v3 |> 
  left_join(AMR_subclass_counts_wide, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  mutate(Specimen = ifelse(Specimen == "Bloodstream", "Blood", Specimen)) |> 
  relocate(13217:13249, .after = qnrD1_presence) |> 
  left_join(genome_seq_status, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  # Now I need pres/abs encoding of genes, not just allelic presence. Otherwise I will split signal
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(categorical_cols_list_bacterial),
      ~ if_else(is.na(.), 0L, 1L),
      .names = "{.col}_presence"
    )
  ) |>
  # Remove pointless cols
  select(-c(13251:13256, YbST_presence, CbST_presence, AbST_presence, SmST_presence, RmST_presence)) |> 
  relocate(13251:13330, .after = O_type) |> 
  # I need to replace any NAs with "Absent" for ML training
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(categorical_cols_list_bacterial),
      ~ if_else(is.na(.) & Genome_sequenced == "Yes", "Absent", .)
    )
  ) |> 
  # Remove genome_sequenced as its not useful in the ML matrix
  select(-c(Genome_sequenced)) |> 
  # Remove 0 variance cols (shouldn't be any!)
  select(
    where(~ !is.numeric(.) || var(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  ) |> 
  # Remove any cols where they are all NA
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))
write_tsv(genome_mdata_v4, "Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v4.tsv")




```

```{r Comparison of 3 models - 30 mins vs full vs genomic only - Fig. 5}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidytext)
library(patchwork)

### Load data

# full dataset stats
full_dataset_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/cv_metrics_all_outcomes.tsv") |> 
  mutate(
    Model_strategy = "Full dataset",
    Model_number = "Model i"
    )

# Genomics only stats
genome_only_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/genomics_only/v4/output/cv_metrics_all_outcomes.tsv") |> 
  mutate(
    Model_strategy = "K. pneumoniae genomic",
    Model_number = "Model ii"
    )


# 30 minute stats
clin_30_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/30_min_clinical_pass_2/v4/output/cv_metrics_all_outcomes.tsv") |> 
  mutate(
    Model_strategy = "Clinical within 30 minutes",
    Model_number = "Model iii"
    )


### Manip

# Combine all together for plotting
combined_metrics <- bind_rows(
  full_dataset_metrics,
  genome_only_metrics,
  clin_30_metrics
  ) |> 
  relocate(Model_strategy, Model_number, .before = outcome) |> 
  select(1:17) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " "),
    outcome = str_remove(outcome, " binary"),
    outcome = ifelse(outcome == "Vasoactive", "Vasoactive use", outcome)
  ) |> 
  group_by(Model_strategy, Model_number, outcome, model) |> 
  mutate(
    median_balanced_accuracy = median(balanced_accuracy),
    IQR_balanced_accuracy = IQR(balanced_accuracy)
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(Model_strategy, Model_number, outcome) |> 
  slice_max(median_balanced_accuracy, n = 1) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(Model_strategy = factor(Model_strategy, levels = c("Full dataset", "Clinical within 30 minutes", "K. pneumoniae genomic"))) |> 
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Sepsis", "Septic shock", "Respiratory support", "Vasoactive use", "Initial treatment failure", "Readmission", "Reinfection")))

total_metrics <- combined_metrics |> 
  select(Model_strategy, Model_number, median_balanced_accuracy) |> 
  group_by(Model_strategy, Model_number) |> 
  summarise()
  

combined_metrics_scores <- combined_metrics |> 
  group_by(Model_strategy, outcome) |> 
  summarise(
    median_bal_acc = round(median(balanced_accuracy) * 100, 2),

# Test for data variance
variance_test <- combined_metrics |>

# Oookay so above >0.05 means normal, but low n so..

# qqplot looks good.

combined_metrics_small <- combined_metrics |>

    )
    )

write_tsv(combined_metrics_small, "ML_predictions/30_min_clinical_pass_2/v4/output/combined_metrics_small.tsv")

write_tsv(combined_metrics, "ML_predictions/30_min_clinical_pass_2/v4/output/combined_metrics.tsv")

### Vus
```

```{r Virulence alleles - all for genomic input data - truncations and polytracts and updating genomic mdata v5}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)

### Load data

# Metadata
genome_mdata_v2 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v2.tsv")

# GetAlleles
virulence_alleles_combined <- read_tsv("virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/virulence_alleles_combined.tsv") |> 
  unique()

# Fasta seqs
vir_allele_seqs <- read_tsv("virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/combined_vir_allele_seqs.tsv")


# # Reference genes
ref_genes <- read_tsv("virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/combined_ref_genes.tsv") |>
  mutate(Reference_nucl_seq = str_to_upper(Reference_nucl_seq))


### Functions

get_first_indel_info <- function(cigar) {
  if (!str_detect(cigar, "[ID]")) {
    return(tibble(ref_pos = NA_integer_,
                  query_pos = NA_integer_,
                  op = NA_character_,
                  len = NA_integer_))
  }
  
  parts <- str_match_all(cigar, "(\\d+)([MID])")[[1]]
  lens  <- as.integer(parts[,2])
  ops   <- parts[,3]
  
  ref_pos <- 0
  query_pos <- 0
  
  for (i in seq_along(lens)) {
    
    if (ops[i] == "M") {
      ref_pos   <- ref_pos + lens[i]
      query_pos <- query_pos + lens[i]
      
    } else if (ops[i] == "D") {
      return(tibble(ref_pos = ref_pos + 1,
                    query_pos = query_pos + 1,
                    op = "D",
                    len = lens[i]))
      
    } else if (ops[i] == "I") {
      return(tibble(ref_pos = ref_pos + 1,
                    query_pos = query_pos + 1,
                    op = "I",
                    len = lens[i]))
    }
  }
}


is_polytract_at_pos <- function(seq, pos, min_run = 6) {
  if (is.na(pos)) return(FALSE)
  
  base <- substr(seq, pos, pos)
  if (!base %in% c("A","C","G","T")) return(FALSE)
  
  left <- pos
  while (left > 1 && substr(seq, left - 1, left - 1) == base) {
    left <- left - 1
  }
  
  right <- pos
  while (right < nchar(seq) && substr(seq, right + 1, right + 1) == base) {
    right <- right + 1
  }
  
  (right - left + 1) >= min_run
}


# Net indel function: sum(I) - sum(D)
get_net_indel <- function(cigar) {
  parts <- stringr::str_match_all(cigar, "(\\d+)([ID])")[[1]]
  if (nrow(parts) == 0) return(0)
  
  lens <- as.integer(parts[,2])
  ops  <- parts[,3]
  
  sum(ifelse(ops == "I", lens,
             ifelse(ops == "D", -lens, 0)))
}

# Vectorized first-indel frameshift
has_frameshift_vec <- Vectorize(function(cigar) {
  first <- get_first_indel_info(cigar)
  if (is.na(first$len)) return(FALSE)
  first$len %% 3 != 0
})



### Manip

# Add fasta seqs and classify results as truncations using CIGARs
GetAlleles_results <- virulence_alleles_combined |>
  left_join(vir_allele_seqs, by = "DNA_hash") |> 
  # # Fix AA length
  # mutate(
  #   Ref_AA_length = Ref_DNA_length / 3
  #   ) |> 
  left_join(ref_genes, by = "Reference")
  # select(-c(3:6, 15, 16))

is_stop_codon <- function(seq) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(seq) | nchar(seq) < 3,
    FALSE,
    substr(seq, nchar(seq) - 2, nchar(seq)) %in% c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")
  )
}

# Process GetAlleles results for frameshifts
GetAlleles_frameshifts <- GetAlleles_results |>
  mutate(
    match = ifelse(AA_length == Ref_AA_length, "Yes", "No")) |> 
  # filter(match == "No" | !is.na(Problems)) |> 
  mutate(Gene = str_remove(Reference, "_.*$"), .before = Reference) |> 
  # Calculate best hit to keep as well
  mutate(
    prop_DNA_coverage = DNA_length / Ref_DNA_length,
    prop_AA_coverage = AA_length / Ref_AA_length
    ) |> 
  group_by(Gene, Assembly) |> 
  mutate(number_of_contigs_hit_for_IS = n()) |>
  arrange(
    desc(prop_DNA_coverage),
    desc(prop_AA_coverage),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(indel_info = map(Cigar, get_first_indel_info)) |>
  unnest(indel_info) |>
  mutate(
    frameshift = has_frameshift_vec(Cigar),   # first-indel frameshift
    net_indel = get_net_indel(Cigar),         # sum(I-D) for optional filtering
    net_indel_frameshift = net_indel %% 3 != 0,  # TRUE/FALSE for net indel divisible by 3
    polytract_at_indel = case_when(
      op == "I" ~ map2_lgl(nucl_seq, query_pos, is_polytract_at_pos),
      op == "D" ~ map2_lgl(Reference_nucl_seq, ref_pos, is_polytract_at_pos),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

GetAlleles_frameshifts_2 <- GetAlleles_frameshifts |> 
  mutate(stop_codon_present = is_stop_codon(nucl_seq))

# Create rules for gene status
GetAlleles_processed <- GetAlleles_frameshifts_2 |>
  mutate(Gene_status = case_when(
    AA_length == Ref_AA_length & Identity == 100 & Coverage == 100 ~ "Intact",
    DNA_length / Ref_DNA_length >= 0.90 & AA_length / Ref_AA_length >= 0.90 & is_stop_codon(nucl_seq) & !frameshift & stop_codon_present == TRUE ~ "Intact",
    AA_length < Ref_AA_length & str_detect(Cigar, "[ID]") & frameshift == TRUE & polytract_at_indel == TRUE ~ "Indel - polytract",
    AA_length < Ref_AA_length & str_detect(Cigar, "[ID]") & frameshift == TRUE & polytract_at_indel == FALSE ~ "Indel",
    number_of_contigs_hit_for_IS > 1 & AA_length < Ref_AA_length & stop_codon_present == FALSE ~ "Partial gene loss or IS interruption",
    # Edge cases
    number_of_contigs_hit_for_IS > 1 & AA_length < Ref_AA_length ~ "Partial gene loss or IS interruption",
    stop_codon_present == FALSE ~ "Partial gene loss or IS interruption",
    stop_codon_present == TRUE & prop_DNA_coverage >= 0.9 & prop_AA_coverage < 0.9 ~ "Nonsense mutation",
    stop_codon_present == TRUE & prop_DNA_coverage < 0.9 & prop_AA_coverage < 0.9 ~ "Partial gene loss or IS interruption",
    AA_length == Ref_AA_length ~ "Intact",
    TRUE ~ "AAAAA"
    # DNA_length / Ref_DNA_length < 0.90 & AA_length / Ref_AA_length < 0.90 & is_stop_codon(nucl_seq) & !frameshift ~ "Nonsense mutation",
    # DNA_length < Ref_DNA_length ~ "Partial gene loss",
    # AA_length < Ref_AA_length & frameshift == TRUE & polytract_at_indel == TRUE ~ "Indel - polytract",
    # AA_length < Ref_AA_length & !str_detect(Cigar, "[ID]") ~ "Truncation - IS",
    # AA_length < Ref_AA_length & !frameshift ~ "Truncation - stop",
    # AA_length > Ref_AA_length & !frameshift ~ "Intact - larger variant",
    # AA_length > Ref_AA_length ~ "Intact - larger variant",
    # AA_length > Ref_AA_length & net_indel_frameshift == FALSE ~ "Intact - larger variant",
  )) |> 
  relocate(Gene_status, .after = Gene)
write_tsv(GetAlleles_processed, "virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/GetAlleles_processed.tsv")

# Count
GetAlleles_processed_counts <- GetAlleles_processed |>
  group_by(Assembly, Gene) |> 
  mutate(multiple_statuses = n_distinct(Gene_status)) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(Assembly, Gene_status, Gene) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(Gene, Gene_status) |> 
  summarise(total_count = n()) |> 
  group_by(Gene) |> 
  mutate(total_count_per_gene = sum(total_count)) |> 
  ungroup()

GetAlleles_all_col <- ggplot(GetAlleles_processed_counts, aes(x = reorder(Gene, -total_count_per_gene), y = total_count, fill = Gene_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0, 0.01, 0)) +
  scale_fill_discrete_qualitative(palette = "Harmonic") +
  labs(
    x = "Virulence-associated gene",
    y = "Number of genomes",
    fill = "Truncation type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
GetAlleles_all_col
ggsave(file="virulence_factors_alleles/GetAlleles_all_col.png", plot=GetAlleles_all_col, width=9, height=5)

# Extract intact seqs for Maggie
intact_seqs_maggie <- GetAlleles_processed |>
  filter(Gene_status == "Intact") |> 
  select(Gene, Kleborate_reference = Reference, DNA_hash, AA_hash, nucl_seq) |> 
  unique()
write_tsv(intact_seqs_maggie, "virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/maggie_zip/intact_seqs_maggie.tsv")

# Now extract relevant data for combining with mdata_v4 for mdata_v5
GetAlleles_processed_min <- GetAlleles_processed |> 
  select(
    Infecting_isolate = Assembly,
    Gene, DNA_hash, trunc_status = Gene_status
  ) |> 
  mutate(presence = ifelse(trunc_status %in% c("Indel", "Indel - polytract", "Intact", "Nonsense mutation"), 1, 0))

gene_hash_wide <- GetAlleles_processed_min |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Gene",
    values_from = c(DNA_hash, trunc_status, presence),
    names_glue = "{Gene}_{.value}"
    ) |> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_presence"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))
write_tsv(gene_hash_wide, "virulence_factors_alleles/results_r3/maggie_zip/subsetted_ML_matrix.tsv")


## Now merge this truncation type data back to the v4 dataset
genome_mdata_v4 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v4.tsv")

# Join new data
genome_mdata_v4.5 <- genome_mdata_v4 |> 
  relocate(CbST, Colibactin, AbST, Aerobactin, SmST, Salmochelin, RmST, RmpADC, .after = Yersiniabactin) |> 
  # Remove current Kleborate calls
  select(-c(21:58, 60)) |> 
  # Remove current presence calls for vir genes
  select(-c(56:66, 68:82, 84:88, 90:93, 95:98)) |> 
  # Now join my new df
  left_join(gene_hash_wide, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  # Relocate cols for ease of downstream analysis
  relocate(13252:last_col(), .after = RmpADC_presence) |> 
  # Now I need to mutate across to replace NAs with "Absent"
  mutate(across(60:137, ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Absent", .))) |> 
  # Now I need to do pres/abs mutations from NA to 0
  mutate(across(138:176, ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

## Add the carbapenem data from AMRFinderPlus
AMRFinder_results <- read_tsv("AMRFinderPlus/combined_AMR_data.tsv")

# Get Carb data only
carb_data <- AMRFinder_results |> 
  filter(
    Subclass == "CARBAPENEM",
    !str_detect(`Element symbol`, "ompK")
    ) |> 
  group_by(Filename) |> 
  summarise(carb_acq = toString(unique(`Element symbol`), sep = ";")) |>
  mutate(
    carb_acq = case_when(
      carb_acq == "blaKPC, blaKPC-3" ~ "blaKPC-3",
      carb_acq == "blaKPC-3, blaKPC" ~ "blaKPC-3",
      TRUE ~ carb_acq
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    carb_acq = str_replace(carb_acq, ", ", " + ")
  )

carb_data_count <- carb_data |> 
  group_by(carb_acq) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

## Now let's do final prep to remove weird cols I don't need
genome_mdata_v5 <- genome_mdata_v4.5 |> 
  select(-c(Ciprofloxacin_MIC_prediction, Ciprofloxacin_prediction)) |> 
  left_join(carb_data, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Filename")) |> 
  # Fix missing data
  mutate(carb_acq = case_when(
    is.na(carb_acq) & Bla_Carb_acquired == "Absent" ~ "Absent",
    TRUE ~ carb_acq
    )
  ) |> 
  relocate(carb_acq, .after = Bla_Carb_acquired) |> 
  select(-c(Bla_Carb_acquired)) |> 
  rename(Bla_Carb_acquired = carb_acq) |> 
  # Finally make sure the isolates without genomes only have NA in genomic cols!
  mutate(across(10:last_col(), ~ ifelse(is.na(time_weighted_SNV_cluster), NA_character_, .)))
write_tsv(genome_mdata_v5, "Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v5.tsv")
```

```{r Round 1 ML matrix generation}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Patient mdata
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")

# Full genomic data

specimen_count <- genome_mdata_v5 |> 
  group_by(Specimen) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

### Manip dfs

# Update patient data to ensure numerics
combined_patient_mdata_v5.1 <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  mutate(across(
    c(Serum_C_Reactive_Protein_mg_L, Procalcitonin, Uric_Acid, Lipase, Creatine_Kinase_Isoenzymes, Creatine_Kinase, CKMB_CK, Urea, TCO2, K_potassium, Amylase, Y_glutamyltransferase, Fibrinogen_Degradation_Products, D_Dimer),
    ~ as.numeric(str_remove(., "<|>"))
  ))


# Create ML combined matrix
merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 <- genome_mdata_v5 |> 
  left_join(combined_patient_mdata_v5.1, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  # Remove cols with NA only
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) |> 
  # Fix weird headers
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(., "[()]", "_")) |> 
  # Why is there ND lmao
  mutate(across(1:last_col(), ~ str_replace_all(., "^ND$", NA_character_))) |> 
  select(-c(
    Dataset,
    Species,
    Pulsotype,
    Date,
    Poor_prognosis_14_day,
    Poor_prognosis_28_day,
    Poor_prognosis_90_day,
    Poor_prognosis_within_hospital,
    Mortality_14_day,
    Mortality_28_day,
    Mortality_90_day
    )
  ) |> 
  # Ensure all numeric cols are numeric
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (
        all(is.na(.) | str_detect(as.character(.), "^[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+$"))
        ) {
    as.numeric(.)
    } else {
      .
      }
    )
  )
write_tsv(merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/input/merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1.tsv")


categorical_cols_list <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 %>%
  select(where(is.character)) %>%
  colnames()
write_lines(categorical_cols_list, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/input/categorical_cols_list.txt")
```

```{Network of outbreak clusters}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggforce)
library(qgraph)
library(colorspace)

### Load data

amr_data <- read_tsv("AMRFinderPlus/combined_AMR_data.tsv")


# Seperate out beta-lactams..
ESBL_carb_status <- amr_data |> 
  group_by(Filename) |> 
  summarise(
    CARBAPENEM = ifelse(any(str_detect(`Subclass`, "CARBAPENEM")), "Carb", NA_character_),
    ESBL = ifelse(any(str_detect(`Element name`, "extended-spectrum")), "ESBL",  NA_character_),
    CEPHALOSPORIN = ifelse(!any(str_detect(`Element name`, "extended-spectrum")) & any(str_detect(`Subclass`, "CEPHALOSPORIN")), "Cephalosporin",  NA_character_)
    )

# Now do class counts
class_counts_per_genome <- amr_data |>
  # Keep relevant classes as per Magiorakos et al 2012
  filter(
    str_detect(Class, "AMINOGLYCOSIDE") |
    str_detect(Subclass, "CARBAPENEM") |
    str_detect(Subclass, "CEPHALOSPORIN") |
    str_detect(Class, "QUINOLONE") |
    str_detect(Subclass, "TIGECYCLINE") |
    str_detect(Subclass, "CHLORAMPHENICOL") |
    str_detect(Class, "FOSFOMYCIN") |
    str_detect(Class, "COLISTIN") |
    str_detect(Class, "TETRACYCLINE")
  ) |> 
  # filter stuff ive already partitioned out
  filter(
    !str_detect(Subclass, "CARBAPENEM"),
    !str_detect(`Element name`, "extended-spectrum"),
    !str_detect(`Subclass`, "CEPHALOSPORIN")
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Class", values_from = `Element symbol`, id_cols = "Filename", values_fn = \(x) paste(x, collapse = "; ")) |>
  left_join(ESBL_carb_status, by = "Filename") |> 
  # mutate(
  #   CARBAPENEM = ifelse(resistance_status %in% c("Carbapenem", "Carbapenem+ESBL"), "Carb", NA_character_),
  #   ESBL = ifelse(resistance_status %in% c("ESBL", "Carbapenem+ESBL"), "ESBL", NA_character_)
  # )
  mutate(
    num_classes_resistant = rowSums(!is.na(across(2:last_col()))),
    total_classes = length(2:12)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    AMR_status_classification = case_when(
      num_classes_resistant >= 3 & num_classes_resistant < ( total_classes - 2 ) ~ "MDR",
      num_classes_resistant >= ( total_classes - 2 ) ~ "XDR",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    AMR_status_classification2 = paste(AMR_status_classification, CARBAPENEM, sep = "+"),
    AMR_status = str_remove(AMR_status_classification2, "\\+NA")
    ) |> 
  select(Filename, AMR_status_classification, num_classes_resistant, total_classes)

# merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1$Ciprofloxacin_prediction
genome_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v5.tsv")

# pulsotype <- genome_mdata_v4 |>

#   filter(count > 1 & count < 1177)

### Manip dfs

# Let's get the virulence and AMR features first
outbreak_network_df <- genome_mdata_v5 |>
  filter(!is.na(time_weighted_SNV_cluster)) |> 
  select(1, 4, 5, Dataset, Yersiniabactin_presence, Colibactin_presence, Aerobactin_presence, Salmochelin_presence, rmpA_presence, rmpA2_presence, `peg-344_allele_presence`, `peg-589_allele_presence`, iroB_presence, iucA_presence, virulence_score) |>  # matches("_resistance_counts_AMRFP")
  # Cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP, Carbapenem_resistance_counts_AMRFP, Colistin_resistance_counts_AMRFP, Tigecycline_resistance_counts_AMRFP, Cefiderocol_cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP
  # Calculate a custom virulence count for node info
  mutate(
    total_virulence_count = (Yersiniabactin_presence + Colibactin_presence + Aerobactin_presence + Salmochelin_presence + rmpA_presence + rmpA2_presence + `peg-344_allele_presence` + `peg-589_allele_presence`),
    virulence_gene_binary = ifelse(total_virulence_count >= 1, "Virulence gene/s present", "None")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    russo_hv_count = ( rmpA_presence + rmpA2_presence + `peg-344_allele_presence` + iroB_presence + iucA_presence )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    russo_hv_status = case_when(
      russo_hv_count == 5 ~ "hv",
      russo_hv_count <= 4 ~ NA_character_
      )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Virulence_intersection = paste0(
      ifelse(Yersiniabactin_presence >= 1, "ybt+", ""),
      ifelse(Colibactin_presence >= 1, "clb+", ""),
      ifelse(Aerobactin_presence >= 1, "iuc+", ""),
      ifelse(Salmochelin_presence >= 1, "iro+", ""),
      ifelse(rmpA_presence >= 1, "rmpA+", ""),
      ifelse(rmpA2_presence >= 1, "rmpA2+", ""),
      ifelse(`peg-344_allele_presence` >= 1, "peg-344+", ""),
      ifelse(`peg-589_allele_presence` >= 1, "peg-589+", "")
    ) %>%
      str_remove("\\+$")  # Remove trailing +
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Virulence_intersection = str_replace(Virulence_intersection, "NANANANANA", NA_character_)
    ) |> 
  left_join(class_counts_per_genome, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Filename")) |> 
  # group_by(Infecting_isolate) |> 
  # mutate(
  #   total_AMR_class_count = (sum(across(matches("_resistance_counts_AMRFP"))))
    # total_AMR_class_count = (
    #   ifelse(Cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, 1, 0) +
    #   ifelse(Carbapenem_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, 1, 0) +
    #   ifelse(Colistin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, 1, 0) +
    #   ifelse(Tigecycline_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, 1, 0) +
    #   ifelse(Cefiderocol_cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, 1, 0)
    #     )
  # ) |>
  # ungroup()
  # mutate(
  #   AMR_intersection = paste0(
  #     ifelse(Cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, "ESBL+", ""),
  #     ifelse(Carbapenem_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, "Carb+", ""),
  #     ifelse(Colistin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, "Colistin+", ""),
  #     ifelse(Tigecycline_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, "Tigec+", ""),
  #     ifelse(Cefiderocol_cephalosporin_resistance_counts_AMRFP >= 1, "Cefiderocol+", "")
  #   ) %>%
  #     str_remove("\\+$")  # Remove trailing +
  # ) |> 
  # mutate(
  #   AMR_intersection = str_replace(AMR_intersection, "NANANANANA", NA_character_)) |> 
  #   mutate_if(is.character, list(~na_if(.,""))) |> 
  # # Look for intersection of MDR and hv
  # mutate(
  #   Genotype = case_when(
  #     AMR_status_classification == "Other" & total_virulence_count == 0 ~ "Common",
  #     AMR_status_classification == "MDR" & total_virulence_count == 0 ~ "MDR",
  #     AMR_status_classification == "MDR" & total_virulence_count >= 1 ~ "MDR+hv",
  #     total_AMR_class_count >= 3 & total_AMR_class_count <= 4 & total_virulence_count == 0 ~ "XDR",
  #     total_AMR_class_count >= 3 & total_AMR_class_count <= 4 & total_virulence_count >= 1 ~ "XDR+hv",
  #     total_AMR_class_count >= 5 & total_virulence_count == 0 ~ "PDR",
  #     total_AMR_class_count >= 5 & total_virulence_count >= 1 ~ "PDR+hv",
  #     total_AMR_class_count == 0 & total_virulence_count >= 1 ~ "hv",
  #     TRUE ~ "AAAA"
  #   )
  # ) |> 
  mutate(
    Genotype_Russo = case_when(
      AMR_status_classification == "Other" & is.na(russo_hv_status) ~ "Common",
      AMR_status_classification == "MDR" & is.na(russo_hv_status) ~ "MDR",
      AMR_status_classification == "MDR" & !is.na(russo_hv_status) ~ "MDR+hv",
      AMR_status_classification == "XDR" & is.na(russo_hv_status) ~ "XDR",
      AMR_status_classification == "XDR" & !is.na(russo_hv_status) ~ "XDR+hv",
      AMR_status_classification == "Other" & !is.na(russo_hv_status) >= 1 ~ "hv",

    )) |>

write_tsv(outbreak_network_df, "Dataset/genome_metadata/outbreak_network_df.tsv")
```

```{r Virulence statistics on outcomes}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(logistf)
library(broom)

### Load data

genome_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v5.tsv")


combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")

### Manip

patient_data_min <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(1, Mortality_binary, Poor_prognosis_binary, Reinfection, Readmission, Initial_treatment_failure, Sepsis, Septic_shock, Respiratory_support, Vasoactive)

# Get reduced dataset of all vir genes
vir_genes <- genome_mdata_v5 |>
  rename(peg_344_allele_presence = `peg-344_allele_presence`) |> 
  filter(!is.na(time_weighted_SNV_cluster)) |> 
  select(1, 5, Dataset, Yersiniabactin_presence, Colibactin_presence, Aerobactin_presence, Salmochelin_presence, RmpADC_presence, iucA_allele_presence, iroB_allele_presence, peg_344_allele_presence, rmpA_allele_presence, rmpA2_allele_presence) |> 
  mutate(
    Russo_hv_count = ( rmpA_allele_presence + rmpA2_allele_presence + peg_344_allele_presence + iroB_allele_presence + iucA_allele_presence )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Russo_hv_status = case_when(
      Russo_hv_count == 5 ~ "hv",
      Russo_hv_count <= 4 ~ "Non-hv"
      )
  ) |> 
  left_join(patient_data_min, by = "Infecting_isolate")

# unique(sel_vir_genes$Mortality_binary)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Yb_pres)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Cb_pres)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Mortality_binary)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Mortality_binary)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Mortality_binary)
# unique(sel_vir_genes$Mortality_binary)

# Get a list of genomic virulence predictors
predictors <- c(
  "Yersiniabactin_presence",
  "Colibactin_presence",
  "Aerobactin_presence",
  "Salmochelin_presence",
  "RmpADC_presence",
  "Russo_hv_status",
  "iucA_allele_presence",
  "iroB_allele_presence",
  "peg_344_allele_presence",
  "rmpA_allele_presence",
  "rmpA2_allele_presence"
  )

# Fit a glm to this for each variable
fit <- glm(Mortality_binary ~ paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), 
  data = vir_genes,
  family = binomial
  ) # Yb_pres + Cb_pres + Ab_pres + Iro_pres +
    rmpA_pres + rmpA2_pres + peg_344_pres + peg_589_pres,

glm_output <- tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
# Ah I have complete separation - need Firth's


# I can't use the smaller outcome list as they dont have enough observations. No worries. Use best-performing models
outcome_list <- c(
  'Mortality_binary',
  # 'Reinfection',
  # 'Readmission',
  'Poor_prognosis_binary',
  # 'Initial_treatment_failure',
  'Sepsis'
  # 'Septic_shock'
  # 'Respiratory_support',
  # 'Vasoactive'
  )

# predictors <- c("Yb_pres", "Cb_pres", "Ab_pres", "Iro_pres", "rmpA_pres", "rmpA2_pres", "peg_344_pres", "peg_589_pres", "Russo_hv_status")

unique(vir_genes$Mortality_binary)
all_results <- list()

for (out in outcome_list) {
  print(out)
  
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste(out, "~", paste(sprintf("`%s`", predictors), collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  # Filter rows where the outcome is not NA
  new_sel_vir_genes <- vir_genes |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[out]])) |> 
    drop_na(all_of(predictors))
  
  # Fit firth's
  fit <- logistf(formula, data = new_sel_vir_genes)
  
  # Extract results
  tmp <- data.frame(
    Outcome = out,
    Variable = names(coef(fit))[-1],
    OR = exp(coef(fit))[-1],
    LCI = exp(fit$ci.lower)[-1],
    UCI = exp(fit$ci.upper)[-1],
    p_value = fit$prob[-1]
  )
  
  all_results[[out]] <- tmp

}

firths_log_reg_virulence <- bind_rows(all_results) |> 
  mutate(p_adj_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) |> 
  mutate(signif = case_when(
    p_adj_holm <= 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p_adj_holm <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_adj_holm <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_adj_holm <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_adj_holm > 0.05 ~ "ns"
  )) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  arrange(p_adj_holm)
write_tsv(firths_log_reg_virulence, "virulence_factors_alleles/firths_log_reg_virulence.tsv")
```

```{r ML training matrix v1 predictor counts for rarity}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Feature selection cutoff for 30 minute features - v2 training results}
# # Remove the averages from v2 results

  select(c(1:5)) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(panel_group = interaction(outcome, model))

## Statistics to compare if there are any diffs between the feature counts in terms of AUC

# Kruskal test on genes to compare if genes
v2_feature_selection_metrics_kruskal <- compare_means(data = v2_feature_selection_metrics, auc ~ top_n_features, group.by = c("outcome", "model"), method = "kruskal.test", p.adjust.method = "holm") # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method  # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method =' # group.by = "group",

# None were significant - so no post hoc tests

#   filter(outcome %in% c("Sepsis", "Septic_shock")) |> 
#   group_by(outcome, model) |>
#   dunn_test(auc ~ top_n_features, p.adjust.method = "holm") # from rstatix 


# Just one kruskal per plot...
n_feature_selection_30_mins <- ggplot(all_targets_top_n_metrics, 
             aes(x = as.factor(top_n_features),

  # Boxplots with dodge positioning
  geom_boxplot(

    label = "p = {p.adj}",

    geom = "text",

    label.y.npc = "bottom",
    label.x = 3,

  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c(
    "CatBoost" = "grey80",

      )
    ) + 
  scale_x_discrete(

    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
n_feature_selection_30_mins
```

```{r Final model evaluation 30 minute features - v4 training results}

### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(moments)
library(brunnermunzel)

### Load data

# Model performance
cv_metrics_all_outcomes_v4 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/30_minute_clin_model/v4/output/cv_metrics_all_outcomes.tsv")

# Clinical outcomes for tagging
combined_patient_mdata_v4 <- read_tsv(
  "Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v4.tsv"
  )

# Outcome list
outcome_list <- c(
  'Mortality',
  'Reinfection',
  'Readmission',
  'Poor prognosis',
  'Initialtreatment failure',
  'Sepsis',
  'Septicshock',
  'Respiratorysupport',
  'Vasoactive'
  )


### Manip

# Longerise for plotting and stats
cv_metrics_all_outcomes_long <- cv_metrics_all_outcomes_v4 |> 
  mutate(
    Sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
    Specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
    balanced_accuracy = (Sensitivity + Specificity) / 2
  ) |> 
  select(-c(16:23, seed)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(4:17), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

# Prep df for boxplot vis
plot_cv_metrics_df <- cv_metrics_all_outcomes_long |> 
  filter(!Metric %in% c("youden_j", "optimal_threshold", "tp", "tn", "fp", "fn")) |> 
  mutate(Metric = case_when(
    Metric == "auc" ~ "AUC",
    Metric == "accuracy" ~ "Accuracy",
    Metric == "f1" ~ "F1-score",
    Metric == "logloss" ~ "Log loss",
    Metric == "crossentropy" ~ "Cross-entropy",
    Metric == "balanced_accuracy" ~ "Balanced accuracy",
    TRUE ~ Metric
    )
    ) |> 
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("AUC", "Accuracy", "Balanced accuracy", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "F1-score", "Log loss", "Cross-entropy"))) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "Mortality binary" ~ "Mortality",
    outcome == "Poor prognosis binary" ~ "Poor prognosis",
    outcome == "Vasoactive" ~ "Vasoactive use",
    TRUE ~ outcome
  )
  ) |> 
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Septic shock", "Sepsis", "Respiratory support", "Vasoactive use", "Initial treatment failure", "Readmission", "Reinfection")))

# Looks to be some weird distributions. Run shape check (moments) to see what test to run
shape_check <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  group_by(outcome, Metric, model) |> 
  summarise(
    skewness = skewness(Value),
    kurtosis = kurtosis(Value),
    variance = var(Value)
  )

# Due to unequal variance and different data shapes, running Brunner-Munzel test

#  Run brunnermunzel.test via group_modify and extract tibble of results. stupid R outputs
model_metrics_bm_test <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  group_by(outcome, Metric) |> 
  group_modify(~ {
    # Check if we have at least 2 groups with data
    if (n_distinct(.x$model) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        conf.int_low = NA_real_,
        conf.int_high = NA_real_,
        method = "Insufficient groups"
      ))
    }
    
    # Check sample size per group
    group_counts <- table(.x$model)
    if (any(group_counts < 2)) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        conf.int_low = NA_real_,
        conf.int_high = NA_real_,
        method = paste("Small n:", paste(group_counts, collapse = ", "))
      ))
    }
    
    # Run Brunner-Munzel test
    bm_test <- brunnermunzel.test(Value ~ model, data = .x, perm = TRUE)
    
    # Return tidy results
    tibble(
      statistic = bm_test$statistic,
      p.value = bm_test$p.value,
      estimate = bm_test$estimate,
      conf.int_low = bm_test$conf.int[1],
      conf.int_high = bm_test$conf.int[2],
      method = bm_test$method
    )
  }) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Should calculate p-value adjustment with Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) given the permuted BM test
  mutate(
    p.adj.bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), 
  )

model_metrics_bm_txt_plot <- model_metrics_bm_test |> 
  mutate(
    signif = ifelse(p.adj.bh < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !Metric %in% c("Accuracy", "Cross-entropy"),
    !is.na(Metric)
    )

plot_cv_metrics_df_reduced <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  filter(
    !Metric %in% c("Accuracy", "Cross-entropy"),
    !is.na(Metric)
    )

### Vis

# Compare model metrics and add the 
model_metric_comparison_box <- ggplot(plot_cv_metrics_df_reduced, 
             aes(x = model, 
                 y = Value,
                 fill = model
                 )
             ) +
  # Boxplots with dodge positioning
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),  # This creates side-by-side boxes
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    linewidth = 0.1, 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Jitter points with same dodge positioning
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = model_metrics_bm_txt_plot,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("p =", format(round(p.adj.bh, 3), nsmall = 3)), colour = signif),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 2,
    # vjust = 12,
    size = 3,
    # color = "black"
    show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.2, 1.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c(
    "CatBoost" = "grey80",
    "LightGBM" = "grey20"
      )
    ) + 
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Significance",
                      values = c(
                        "Significant" = "darkred",
                        "Non-significant" = "black"
                        ),
                      drop = FALSE
                      ) +
  facet_grid(Metric ~ outcome) +
  labs(
    x = "Hyperparameter-optimised model",
    y = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
model_metric_comparison_box
ggsave("ML_predictions/30_minute_clin_model/v4/output/model_metric_comparison_box.png", model_metric_comparison_box, width = 14, height = 7)
ggsave("ML_predictions/30_minute_clin_model/v4/output/model_metric_comparison_box.svg", model_metric_comparison_box, width = 14, height = 7)

# Since there is no significant difference, just save the highest median
best_median_model_metrics <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  filter(!is.na(Metric)) |> 
  # select(-c(4:6)) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Metric",
    values_from = "Value",
    values_fill = 0,
    # names_glue = "{.value}_{Feature_value}"
    ) |> 
  group_by(outcome, model) |> 
  mutate(
    median_balanced_accuracy = median(`Balanced accuracy`),
    median_f1 = median(`F1-score`),
    median_sensitivity = median(Sensitivity),
    median_specificity = median(Specificity)
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  arrange(-median_balanced_accuracy) |> 
  slice_max(median_balanced_accuracy, n = 1) |> 
  # since LightGBM also has a higher F1, let's take that
  ungroup()
  # filter(!(str_trim(model) == "CatBoost" &
  #          str_trim(outcome) == "Reinfection"))
write_tsv(best_median_model_metrics, "ML_predictions/30_minute_clin_model/v4/output/best_median_model_metrics.tsv")
```

```{r Feature selection cutoff - v2 training results}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)
library(rstatix)


### Load data

# Results of catboost v2 training
v2_feature_selection_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v2/output/v2_feature_selection_metrics.tsv")


### Manip dfs

# # Remove the averages from v2 results
all_targets_top_n_metrics <- v2_feature_selection_metrics |>
  select(c(1:5)) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " "))

## Statistics to compare if there are any diffs between the feature counts in terms of AUC

# Kruskal test on genes to compare if genes
v2_feature_selection_metrics_kruskal <- compare_means(data = v2_feature_selection_metrics, auc ~ top_n_features, group.by = "outcome", method = "kruskal.test", p.adjust.method = "holm") # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method  # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method =' # group.by = "group",

# None are significant. Report this and no post hoc tests

# Just one kruskal per plot...
single_plot_feature_selection <- ggplot(all_targets_top_n_metrics, 
             aes(x = as.factor(top_n_features), 
                 y = auc, 
                 fill = model,
                 group = interaction(as.factor(top_n_features), model))) +
  # Boxplots with dodge positioning
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),  # This creates side-by-side boxes
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    linewidth = 0.5, 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Jitter points with same dodge positioning
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_kruskal_test(
    label = "p = {p.adj}",
    # label = "KW with Holm, p = {p.adj}",
    p.adjust.method = "holm",
    geom = "text",
    group.by = "outcome",
    label.y.npc = "bottom",
    label.x = "100",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c(
    "CatBoost" = "grey80",
    "LightGBM" = "grey20"
      )
    ) + 
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c("50", "100", "150", "200", "250", "300"), 
    expand = c(0.075, 0.075)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of top-ranked features used for training",
    y = "AUC"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
single_plot_feature_selection
ggsave("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v2/output/single_plot_feature_selection.png", single_plot_feature_selection, width = 14, height = 5)
ggsave("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v2/output/single_plot_feature_selection.pdf", single_plot_feature_selection, width = 14, height = 5)
```

```{r Table S1 combining}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Isolate data scaffold
all_1346_isolates <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/all_1346_isolates.tsv")

genome_assembly_metrics <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_assembly_metrics.tsv")


### Manip

# Merge together
Table_S1 <- all_1346_isolates |> 
  left_join(genome_assembly_metrics, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Genome")) |> 
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(Date),
    Organism = "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
    Genome_sequenced = ifelse(is.na(gfa_dead_ends), "No", "Yes"),
    Host = "Homo sapiens",
    Country = Dataset,
    Clinical_isolate = "Yes",
    BioProject = ifelse(is.na(BioProject) & Genome_sequenced == "Yes", "PRJNA1001665", BioProject),
    City = case_when(
      Country == "Italy" & str_detect(Infecting_isolate, "FA-") ~ "Fano",
      Country == "Italy" & str_detect(Infecting_isolate, "AN-") ~ "Ancona",
      Country == "Italy" & str_detect(Infecting_isolate, "PR-") ~ "Perugia",
      Country == "Italy" & str_detect(Infecting_isolate, "PS-") ~ "Pesaro",
      TRUE ~ City
    )
  ) |> 
  select(-c(Dataset, Organism)) |> 
  relocate(Host, .before = Specimen) |> 
  relocate(Clinical_isolate, .after = Specimen) |> 
  relocate(ST, .after = Sublineage) |> 
  relocate(Genome_sequenced, .after = Clinical_isolate) |> 
  relocate(BioProject, BioSample, Country, City, .after = Genome_sequenced)
write_tsv(Table_S1, "Dataset/Table_S1.tsv")
```

```{r Make overview Fig. 2 of genomic and clinical data}
    mutate(Genotype_Russo = factor(Genotype_Russo, levels = c("XDR", "MDR", "Common", "MDR+hv", "hv")))

count_types <- outbreak_network_df |> 
  group_by(Genotype_Russo) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

### Manip dfs

# Count outcomes for discussion
count_outcomes <- patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Reinfection, Readmission, Initial_treatment_failure, Immunodeficiency,ICU_admission, Initial_treatment_failure, Respiratory_support, Vasoactive, Sepsis, Septic_shock, Poor_prognosis_binary, Mortality_binary) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Reinfection, Readmission, Initial_treatment_failure, Immunodeficiency,ICU_admission, Initial_treatment_failure, Respiratory_support, Vasoactive, Sepsis, Septic_shock, Poor_prognosis_binary, Mortality_binary), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Presence") |> 
  group_by(Outcome, Presence) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

# Midpoint root 
NJ_tree_mid_root <- phytools::midpoint.root(NJ_tree)

# Remove duplicated data..
patient_data_min <- patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(-c(Country))

# Merge together for alluvial plotting
basic_patient_genome_df_v1 <- outbreak_network_df |> 
  left_join(patient_data_min, by = "Infecting_isolate")

  select(Infecting_isolate, Sublineage, Genotype_Russo, virulence_score, Reinfection, Readmission, Initial_treatment_failure, Immunodeficiency,ICU_admission, Initial_treatment_failure, Respiratory_support, Vasoactive, Sepsis, Septic_shock, Poor_prognosis_binary, Mortality_binary) |> 
  # Turns out AN-51 is not an SL37, or at least super distant. For the purposes of this overlay on the plot, let's remove it from the mrca calculation.
  mutate(Sublineage = ifelse(Infecting_isolate == "AN-51", "Unknown", Sublineage)) |> 
  mutate(Sublineage2 = ifelse(Sublineage == "SL37", "SL37", NA_character_))
## Create a list of MRCA nodes for the overlay for ggtree to highlight SLs/STs

# Let's grab sublineages for overlays for people obsessed with STs...
SLs_n_25_list <- basic_patient_genome_df_v2 |> 
  group_by(Sublineage) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |> 
  # Get df and list of SLs >= 25 n

  pull(Sublineage)

# Get reduced df of genome metadata for mrca analysis
basic_SL_data <- basic_patient_genome_df_v2 |> 
  select(1, 2) |>

mrca_dfs <- map_dfr(SLs_n_25_list, function(SL) {
  filtered_data <- basic_SL_data |> 
    filter(Sublineage_hilight %in% SL)
  
  list_genomes_in_SL <- filtered_data$Infecting_isolate
  
  mrca_node <- getMRCA(NJ_tree_mid_root, list_genomes_in_SL)
  
  tibble(
    Sublineage_hilight = SL,
    tree_node = as.numeric(mrca_node)
  )
}, .id = NULL) |> 
  # Fix the node for SL37 as its cooked
  mutate(tree_node = ifelse(Sublineage_hilight == "SL37", 1511, tree_node))
```

```{r Waffle plot for Fig. 1B}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggwaffle)
library(patchwork)


### Load data

# Patient metadata
patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")


### Manip

# Number of waffle columns I want
width_var <- 10  
# 
# # Calculate the number of rows needed
# height <- ceiling(nrow(waffle_df) / width_var)

# Generate outcome list to predict on
outcome_list <- c(
  'Mortality_binary',
  'Reinfection',
  'Readmission',
  'Poor_prognosis_binary',
  'Initial_treatment_failure',
  'Sepsis',
  'Septic_shock',
  'Respiratory_support',
  'Vasoactive'
  )


# Create waffle df
waffle_base_df <- patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(1, all_of(outcome_list)) |> 
  rename(
    Mortality = "Mortality_binary",
    Poor_prognosis = "Poor_prognosis_binary"
  )

max_n <- nrow(waffle_base_df)


waffle_funtion <- function(waffle_base_df, outcome, col_width, total_tiles) {

  waffle_filt_df <- waffle_base_df |>
    dplyr::select(Infecting_isolate, all_of(outcome)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]))

  n_obs <- nrow(waffle_filt_df)

  # pad with NA (not 0)
  if (n_obs < total_tiles) {
    waffle_filt_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      waffle_filt_df,
      tibble::tibble(
        Infecting_isolate = rep("padding", total_tiles - n_obs),
        !!outcome := NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  prop_positive <- round(
    sum(waffle_filt_df[[outcome]][!is.na(waffle_filt_df[[outcome]])] == 1) /
      sum(!is.na(waffle_filt_df[[outcome]])),
    3
  )

  waffle_df_arranged <- waffle_filt_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome = factor(.data[[outcome]], levels = c(1, 0))
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(outcome) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      row_index = row_number() - 1,
      x = (row_index %% col_width) + 1,
      y = floor(row_index / col_width) + 1
    )

  ggplot(waffle_df_arranged, aes(x, y, fill = outcome)) +
    geom_waffle(linewidth = 0.05) + # , colour = "grey30"
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Patient\noutcome",
      values = c("1" = "#780C0C", "0" = "grey90"),
      na.value = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " "),
      x = paste0(prop_positive * 100, "%")
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      ylim = c(1, ceiling(total_tiles / col_width))
    ) +
    theme_waffle() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
      )
}

sepsis_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Sepsis", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
septic_shock_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Septic_shock", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
pp_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Poor_prognosis", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
mortality_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Mortality", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
respiratory_sup_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Respiratory_support", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
init_treat_fail_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Initial_treatment_failure", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
vasoactive_waffle <- waffle_funtion(waffle_base_df, "Vasoactive", 20, max_n) + guides(fill = "none")
```

```{r trying word cloud for clinical factors - Fig. S1}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

### Load data

# Patient metadata
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")

### Manip

  'Mortality_binary',
  'Reinfection',
  'Readmission',
  'Poor_prognosis_binary',
  'Initial_treatment_failure',
  'Sepsis',
  'Septic_shock',

  'Vasoactive'
  )


# Count prevalence of each feature
patient_mdata_count <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  # Remove cat variables with 100% - add these in post hoc
  select(-c(Country)) |> 
  # Remouve outcomes
  select(-all_of(outcome_list)) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(!is.na(.)))) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "non_NA_count") |> 
  mutate(
    total_rows = nrow(combined_patient_mdata_v5),
    NA_count = total_rows - non_NA_count,
    prop_complete = non_NA_count / total_rows
  )

# Well-repped features
repped_features <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  # Remove cat variables with 100% - add these in post hoc
  select(-c(Country)) |> 
  # Remouve outcomes
  # select(-all_of(outcome_list)) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(!is.na(.)))) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "non_NA_count") |> 
  mutate(
    total_rows = nrow(combined_patient_mdata_v5),
    NA_count = total_rows - non_NA_count,
    prop_complete = non_NA_count / total_rows
  )

well_repped_features <- repped_features |> 
  filter(prop_complete >=0.7)

poor_repped_features <- repped_features |> 
  filter(prop_complete < 0.1)


patient_mdata_count_indiv <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |>
  # Remove cat variables with 100% - add these in post hoc
  select(-c(Country)) |>
  # Remouve outcomes
  select(-all_of(outcome_list)) |> 
  mutate(across(c(2:last_col()), ~ as.factor(.))) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:last_col()), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Feature_value") |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(Feature_value)) |> 
  group_by(Feature, Feature_value) |> 
  summarise(total_counts = n()) |> 
  group_by(Feature) |> 
  mutate(total_per_feature_no_NA = sum(total_counts)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    feature_type_binary = ifelse(Feature_value == "0", 0, 1)
  ) |> 
  group_by(Feature, feature_type_binary, total_per_feature_no_NA) |> 
  summarise(sum_per_feature_type_binary = sum(total_counts)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(feature_type_binary == 1) |> 
  mutate(prop_positive = sum_per_feature_type_binary / total_per_feature_no_NA)

detect_col_type <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    uniq <- unique(x)

    if (length(uniq) <= 2 && all(uniq %in% c(0, 1))) {
      "Binary"
    } else {
      "Continuous"
    }
  } else {
    uniq <- unique(x)
    if (length(uniq) <= 2) {
      "Binary"
    } else {
      "Categorical"
    }
  }
}
col_types <- tibble(
  Feature = names(combined_patient_mdata_v5),
  data_type = map_chr(combined_patient_mdata_v5, detect_col_type)
)


patient_mdata_count_pre_df <- patient_mdata_count |> 
  left_join(patient_mdata_count_indiv, by = "Feature") |> 
  filter(
    Feature != "Infecting_isolate",
    !str_detect(Feature, "Mortality"),
    !str_detect(Feature, "prognosis")
    ) |> 
  # Get data type
  left_join(col_types, by = "Feature") |> 
  mutate(angle = 90 * sample(-2:2, n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(1, 1, 4, 1, 1))) |> 
  mutate(angle = case_when(
    angle == -180 ~ 0,
    angle == 180 ~ 90,
    angle == -90 ~ 90,
    TRUE ~ angle
  )) |>
  mutate(Feature = str_to_sentence(str_replace_all(Feature, "_", " "))) |> 
  # fix specific names~
  mutate(Feature = case_when(
    str_detect(Feature, "icu") ~ str_replace(Feature, "icu",  "ICU"),
    str_detect(Feature, " kp ") ~ str_replace(Feature, " kp ",  " K. pneumoniae "),
    str_detect(Feature, " bsi ") ~ str_replace(Feature, " bsi ",  " BSI "),
    Feature == "Serum c reactive protein mg l" ~ "C-reactive protein",
    Feature == "Age years" ~ "Age",
    Feature == "Ecmo" ~ "ECMO",
    TRUE ~ Feature
    )
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    Feature = ifelse(Feature == "Icu admission", "ICU admission", Feature),
    data_type = ifelse(Feature == "Sex", "Categorical", data_type)
  )

# Prep df for word cloud
patient_mdata_count_df <- patient_mdata_count_pre_df |> 
  filter(prop_complete >= 0.1) |> 
  mutate(Feature = case_when(
    Feature == "Cerebrovascular disease incl neurological disease" ~ "Cerebrovascular disease",
    Feature == "Appropriate treatment at least 1 active drug" ~ "Appropriate treatment",
    Feature == "Carbapenems exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Carbapenem exposure",
    Feature == "Cephalosporins exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Cephalosporin exposure",
    Feature == "Cephalosporins lactamase inhibitors exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Cephalosporin + β-lactamase inhibitors",
    Feature == "Penicillins exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Penicillin exposure",
    Feature == "Penicillins lactamase inhibitors exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Penicillin + β-lactamase inhibitor exposure",
    Feature == "Previous surgery 3 months preceding bsi" ~ "Prior surgery",
    Feature == "Quinolones exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Quinolone exposure",
    Feature == "Tco2" ~ "tCO2",
    Feature == "Tetracyclines exposure 14 days preceding K. pneumoniae detection" ~ "Tetracycline exposure",
    Feature == "Transferred from hospital healthcare or nursing home" ~ "Transfer from hospital/healthcare/nursing home",
    Feature == "Qsofa" ~ "qSOFA",
    TRUE ~ Feature
    )
  )


### Vis

# Word cloud
set.seed(4112)
wordcloud_patients <- ggplot(

    label = Feature, size = prop_complete,

) + # , angle = angle

  scale_size_area(max_size = 22.5) +

  theme_bw() +

    # panel.border = element_blank()
```

```{r Fig. S4: model v4 benchmarking}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(moments)
library(brunnermunzel)

### Load data

# Model performance
cv_metrics_all_outcomes_v4 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/cv_metrics_all_outcomes.tsv")

# Clincal outcomes for tagging
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv(
  "Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv"
  )

# Outcome list
outcome_list <- c(
  'Mortality',
  'Reinfection',
  'Readmission',
  'Poor prognosis',
  'Initial treatment failure',
  'Sepsis',
  'Septic shock',
  'Respiratory support',
  'Vasoactive'
  )


### Manip

# Longerise for plotting and stats
cv_metrics_all_outcomes_long <- cv_metrics_all_outcomes_v4 |> 
  mutate(
    Sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
    Specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
    balanced_accuracy = (Sensitivity + Specificity) / 2
  ) |> 
  select(-c(16:26, seed)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(4:17), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

# Prep df for boxplot vis
plot_cv_metrics_df <- cv_metrics_all_outcomes_long |> 
  filter(!Metric %in% c("youden_j", "optimal_threshold", "tp", "tn", "fp", "fn")) |> 
  mutate(Metric = case_when(
    Metric == "auc" ~ "AUC",
    Metric == "accuracy" ~ "Accuracy",
    Metric == "f1" ~ "F1-score",
    Metric == "logloss" ~ "Log loss",
    Metric == "crossentropy" ~ "Cross-entropy",
    Metric == "balanced_accuracy" ~ "Balanced accuracy",
    TRUE ~ Metric
    )
    ) |> 
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("AUC", "Accuracy", "Balanced accuracy", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "F1-score", "Log loss", "Cross-entropy"))) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "Mortality binary" ~ "Mortality",
    outcome == "Poor prognosis binary" ~ "Poor prognosis",
    outcome == "Vasoactive" ~ "Vasoactive use",
    TRUE ~ outcome
  )
  ) |> 
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Septic shock", "Sepsis", "Respiratory support", "Vasoactive use", "Initial treatment failure", "Readmission", "Reinfection")))

# Looks to be some weird distributions. Run shape check (moments) to see what test to run
shape_check <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  group_by(outcome, Metric, model) |> 
  summarise(
    skewness = skewness(Value),
    kurtosis = kurtosis(Value),
    variance = var(Value)
  )

# Due to unequal variance and different data shapes, running Brunner-Munzel test

#  Run brunnermunzel.test via group_modify and extract tibble of results. stupid R outputs
model_metrics_bm_test <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  group_by(outcome, Metric) |> 
  group_modify(~ {
    # Check if we have at least 2 groups with data
    if (n_distinct(.x$model) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        conf.int_low = NA_real_,
        conf.int_high = NA_real_,
        method = "Insufficient groups"
      ))
    }
    
    # Check sample size per group
    group_counts <- table(.x$model)
    if (any(group_counts < 2)) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        conf.int_low = NA_real_,
        conf.int_high = NA_real_,
        method = paste("Small n:", paste(group_counts, collapse = ", "))
      ))
    }
    
    # Run Brunner-Munzel test
    bm_test <- brunnermunzel.test(Value ~ model, data = .x, perm = TRUE)
    
    # Return tidy results
    tibble(
      statistic = bm_test$statistic,
      p.value = bm_test$p.value,
      estimate = bm_test$estimate,
      conf.int_low = bm_test$conf.int[1],
      conf.int_high = bm_test$conf.int[2],
      method = bm_test$method
    )
  }) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Should calculate p-value adjustment with Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) given the permuted BM test
  mutate(
    p.adj.bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), 
  )

model_metrics_bm_txt_plot <- model_metrics_bm_test |> 
  mutate(
    signif = ifelse(p.adj.bh < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
  ) |> 
  filter(!Metric %in% c("Accuracy", "Cross-entropy"))

plot_cv_metrics_df_reduced <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  filter(!Metric %in% c("Accuracy", "Cross-entropy"))

### Vis

# Compare model metrics and add the 
model_metric_comparison_box <- ggplot(plot_cv_metrics_df_reduced, 
             aes(x = model, 
                 y = Value,
                 fill = model
                 )
             ) +
  # Boxplots with dodge positioning
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),  # This creates side-by-side boxes
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    linewidth = 0.1, 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Jitter points with same dodge positioning
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = model_metrics_bm_txt_plot,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("p =", format(round(p.adj.bh, 3), nsmall = 3)), colour = signif),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 2,
    # vjust = 12,
    size = 3,
    # color = "black"
    show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.2, 1.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c(
    "CatBoost" = "grey80",
    "LightGBM" = "grey20"
      )
    ) + 
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Significance",
                      values = c(
                        "Significant" = "darkred",
                        "Non-significant" = "black"
                        ),
                      drop = FALSE
                      ) +
  facet_grid(Metric ~ outcome) +
  labs(
    x = "Hyperparameter-optimised model",
    y = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
model_metric_comparison_box
ggsave("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/model_metric_comparison_box.png", model_metric_comparison_box, width = 14, height = 7)
ggsave("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/model_metric_comparison_box.svg", model_metric_comparison_box, width = 14, height = 7)

# Since there is no significant difference, just save the highest median
best_median_model_metrics <- plot_cv_metrics_df |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Metric",
    values_from = "Value",
    values_fill = 0,
    # names_glue = "{.value}_{Feature_value}"
    ) |> 
  group_by(outcome, model) |> 
  mutate(
    median_balanced_accuracy = median(`Balanced accuracy`),
    median_f1 = median(`F1-score`),
    median_sensitivity = median(Sensitivity),
    median_specificity = median(Specificity)
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  arrange(-median_balanced_accuracy) |> 
  slice_max(median_balanced_accuracy, n = 1) |> 
  # since LightGBM also has a higher F1, let's take that
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(!(str_trim(model) == "CatBoost" &
           str_trim(outcome) == "Reinfection"))
write_tsv(best_median_model_metrics, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/best_median_model_metrics.tsv")

```


```{r Look at v1 model training to find PopPUNK effects and virulence}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Patient mdata for colheaders
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")

clinical_colnames <- colnames(combined_patient_mdata_v5)


# Genome features
merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/input/merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1.tsv")

# ID columns to keep fixed
id_cols <- c("Infecting_isolate")  # adjust as needed

# Numeric features
num_long <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |> 
  select(all_of(id_cols), where(is.numeric)) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -all_of(id_cols),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_numeric"
  ) |> 
  mutate(feature_value_character = NA_character_)

# Character/factor/logical features
cat_long <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |> 
  select(
    all_of(id_cols),
    where(~ is.character(.) || is.factor(.) || is.logical(.))
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(-all_of(id_cols), as.character)) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -all_of(id_cols),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_character"
  ) |> 
  mutate(feature_value_numeric = NA_real_)

# Combine
merged_matrix_long <- bind_rows(num_long, cat_long) |> 
  mutate(feature_type = ifelse(is.na(feature_value_numeric), "Categorical", "Numeric"))

merged_matrix_long_2 <- merged_matrix_long |> 
  filter(
    !str_detect(feature, "_allele_presence$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "iucA_allele$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "rmpA_allele$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "rmpA2_allele$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "peg-344_allele$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "peg-589_allele$"),
    !str_detect(feature, "iroB_allele$")
  )
write_tsv(merged_matrix_long_2, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/merged_matrix_long_2.tsv")

# Get per-isolate SHAP
CV_aggregated_shap_Mortality_binary <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Mortality_binary.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Vasoactive <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Vasoactive.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Septic_shock <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Septic_shock.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Sepsis <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Sepsis.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Respiratory_support <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Respiratory_support.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Reinfection <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Reinfection.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Readmission <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Readmission.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure.tsv")


### Manip

# Combine SHAP results for ever:
combined_SHAP_report_v1 <- bind_rows(
  CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure,
```
