```{r prep data}

### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)


### Load data

mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes.tsv")

# Best metrics for model use
best_median_model_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/best_median_model_metrics.tsv")

# Actual clinical data for categorising features
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")


## Save a df of the relevant per-isolate SHAP values

# Get per-isolate SHAP
CV_aggregated_shap_Mortality_binary <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Mortality_binary.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Vasoactive <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Vasoactive.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Septic_shock <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Septic_shock.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Sepsis <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Sepsis.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Respiratory_support <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Respiratory_support.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Reinfection <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Reinfection.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Readmission <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Readmission.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary.tsv")
CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure.tsv")


### Manip

# Filter outcomes and tag as clinical or not
signed_SHAP_filtered <- mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "Mortality binary" ~ "Mortality",
    outcome == "Poor prognosis binary" ~ "Poor prognosis",
    outcome == "Vasoactive" ~ "Vasoactive use",
    TRUE ~ outcome
    )
  ) |> 
  left_join(best_median_model_metrics, by = c("outcome", "model")) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(median_balanced_accuracy)
    ) |> 
  select(-c(6:last_col())) |> 
  unique() |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(mean_abs_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Feature_type = case_when(
      feature %in% colnames(combined_patient_mdata_v5) ~ "Clinical",
      feature == "Specimen" ~ "Clinical",
      TRUE ~ "Bacterial genomic"
      )
    )
write_tsv(signed_SHAP_filtered, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/signed_SHAP_filtered.tsv")

# Get relevant outcomes
correct_model <- signed_SHAP_filtered |> 
  select(outcome, model) |> 
  unique()

# Combine SHAP results for ever:
combined_SHAP_report <- bind_rows(
  CV_aggregated_shap_Initial_treatment_failure,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Reinfection,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Readmission,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Respiratory_support,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Sepsis,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Vasoactive,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Septic_shock,
  CV_aggregated_shap_Mortality_binary  
) |> 
  # Fix outcome names
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |>
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "Mortality binary" ~ "Mortality",
    outcome == "Poor prognosis binary" ~ "Poor prognosis",
    outcome == "Vasoactive" ~ "Vasoactive use",
    TRUE ~ outcome
    )
  ) |> 
  inner_join(correct_model, by = c("outcome", "model"))
# unique(combined_SHAP_report$outcome)
write_tsv(combined_SHAP_report, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/combined_SHAP_report.tsv")
```

```{r Signed SHAP for feature types - data prep more}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Clinical outcomes for tagging
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv(
  "Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv"
  )

# Combined SHAP report
combined_SHAP_report <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/combined_SHAP_report.tsv")

# Big df
merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/input/merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1.tsv")


### Manip dfs

# Get pp cluster
PPs <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, PopPUNK_cluster)

# Longerise SHAP report
long_SHAP <- combined_SHAP_report |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Infecting_isolate, outcome, model),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "signed_SHAP"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Feature_type = case_when(
      feature %in% colnames(combined_patient_mdata_v5) ~ "Clinical",
      feature == "Specimen" ~ "Clinical",
      TRUE ~ "Bacterial genomic"
      )
    ) |>
  mutate(Feature_type = factor(Feature_type, levels = c("Clinical", "Bacterial genomic"))) |> 
  left_join(PPs, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  relocate(PopPUNK_cluster, .after = Infecting_isolate)
write_tsv(long_SHAP, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_SHAP.tsv")

# test <- long_SHAP |> 
#   filter(Feature_type == "Bacterial genomic") |> 
#   select(feature, Feature_type) |> 
#   unique()

# Longerise feature values - numeric only as can't combine with cat cols
long_feature_numeric <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |>
  select(PopPUNK_cluster, Infecting_isolate, where(is.numeric)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_num"
  )


# Now do cat cols
long_feature_cat <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |>
  select(
    PopPUNK_cluster,
    Infecting_isolate,
    where(is.character),
    where(is.factor)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PopPUNK_cluster, Infecting_isolate),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_cat"
  )

# Combine
long_features <- full_join(
  long_feature_numeric,
  long_feature_cat,
  by = c("PopPUNK_cluster", "Infecting_isolate", "feature")
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_value = coalesce(
      as.character(feature_value_cat),
      as.character(feature_value_num)
    )
  )


# Now join feature values with feature SHAP
long_feature_values_and_SHAP <- long_SHAP |>
  left_join(
    long_features,
    by = c(
      "Infecting_isolate" = "Infecting_isolate",
      "PopPUNK_cluster" = "PopPUNK_cluster",
      "feature" = "feature"
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(signed_SHAP)
  )

# Determine feature type for handling
feature_types <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    feature_value_type = case_when(
      # Binary numeric
      all(feature_value_num %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE) == 2 ~ "binary",

      # Constant binary (important!)
      all(feature_value_num %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE) == 1 ~ "binary_constant",

      # Categorical
      all(is.na(feature_value_num)) ~ "categorical",

      # Continuous
      TRUE ~ "continuous"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get feature ranges seperately
feature_ranges <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP |>
  left_join(feature_types, by = "feature") |>
  filter(feature_value_type == "continuous") |>
  group_by(outcome, feature) |>
  summarise(
    min_val = min(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_non_na = sum(!is.na(feature_value_num)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    valid_range = n_non_na >= 2 & max_val > min_val
  )

# Merge these back in to the df
long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP |>
  left_join(feature_types, by = "feature") |>
  left_join(feature_ranges, by = c("outcome", "feature")) |>
  mutate(
    feature_scaled_01 = if_else(
      feature_value_type == "continuous" & valid_range,
      (feature_value_num - min_val) / (max_val - min_val),
      NA_real_
    )
  )


# Continuous features only
continuous_features <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 |>
  filter(feature_value_type == "continuous", valid_range) |>
  distinct(feature) |>
  pull()

# Add binning parameters
fd_bins_global <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 |>
  filter(feature %in% continuous_features) |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    min_val_global = min(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val_global = max(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bins = 20L,  # fixed number of bins
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get continious info
continuous_binned <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 |>
  filter(feature_value_type == "continuous", valid_range, !is.na(feature_value_num)) |>
  left_join(fd_bins_global, by = "feature") |>
  mutate(bin_width = (max_val_global - min_val_global) / n_bins) |>
  filter(bin_width > 0) |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  mutate(
    breaks = list(seq(min_val_global[1], max_val_global[1], length.out = n_bins[1] + 1)),
    feature_value_binned = as.character(cut(
      feature_value_num,
      breaks = breaks[[1]],
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      ordered_result = FALSE  # Keep as character
    ))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-breaks)

# Binary features
binary_binned <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 |>
  filter(feature_value_type == "binary") |>
  mutate(feature_value_binned = as.character(feature_value_num))

# Categorical features
categorical_binned <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v2 |>
  filter(feature_value_type == "categorical") |>
  mutate(feature_value_binned = feature_value_cat)

# Combine everything
long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 <- bind_rows(
  continuous_binned,
  binary_binned,
  categorical_binned
)
write_tsv(long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3.tsv")

# Now calculate signed SHAP per feature bin
binned_SHAP_per_feature_value <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |>
  filter(!is.na(signed_SHAP)) |>
  # Calcualte global abs shap as well
  group_by(outcome, feature) |> 
  mutate(
    global_mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(signed_SHAP), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(
    outcome,
    feature,
    Feature_type,
    feature_value_type,
    feature_value_binned,
    global_mean_abs_shap
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_scaled_feature_value = median(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Feature_type = factor(Feature_type, levels = c("Clinical", "Bacterial genomic")))
write_tsv(binned_SHAP_per_feature_value, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/binned_SHAP_per_feature_value.tsv")

long_SHAP_results <- long_SHAP |> 
  group_by(outcome, model, feature, Feature_type) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.nan(mean_abs_SHAP))
write_tsv(long_SHAP_results, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_SHAP_results.tsv")
```

```{r Fig. 3: model v4 figure and key model features}
    median_specificity = median(Specificity),

  )
write_tsv(best_median_model_metrics_v2, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/best_median_model_metrics_v2.tsv")

# Get best model scores for boxplots
model_scores_long <- best_median_model_metrics |> 
  select(-c(12:15)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(4:11), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Metric_value") |> 
  filter(Metric %in% c("Balanced accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity"))

model_scores_x_axis_order <- model_scores_long |> 
  group_by(Metric, outcome) |>
  mutate(median = median(Metric_value)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(Metric %in% c("Balanced accuracy")) |> 
  select(1, 6) |> 
  unique() |> 
  arrange(-median) |>

model_scores_long_v2 <- model_scores_long |> 
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = model_scores_x_axis_order),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Balanced accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity")),
    Model_performance = "Metric value"
    ) |> 
  arrange(outcome, Metric) 

med_scores <- model_scores_long_v2 |> 
  group_by(outcome, Metric) |> 
  summarise(median_metric = round(median(Metric_value), 4) * 100)

# Get proportion of outcome heterogeniety - for scatterplot of accuracy vs outcome data and heterogeniety
class_imbalance_data <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, all_of(outcome_list)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:last_col()), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Feature_value") |> 
  group_by(Feature, Feature_value) |> 
  summarise(feature_count_across_dataset = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Feature_value",
    values_from = "feature_count_across_dataset",
    values_fill = 0,
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Feature_value}"
    ) |> 
  rename(
    outcome = Feature,
    Outcome_negative = feature_count_across_dataset_0,
    Outcome_positive = feature_count_across_dataset_1,
    No_outcome_data = feature_count_across_dataset_NA
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    prop_patients_with_outcome_data = (Outcome_negative + Outcome_positive) / (Outcome_negative + Outcome_positive + No_outcome_data),
    positive_class_ratio = Outcome_positive / (Outcome_negative + Outcome_positive)
  ) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "Mortality binary" ~ "Mortality",
    outcome == "Poor prognosis binary" ~ "Poor prognosis",
    outcome == "Vasoactive" ~ "Vasoactive use",
    TRUE ~ outcome
  )
  )

long_SHAP_results_type <- long_SHAP_results |> 
  # Remove the model I am not using
  left_join(best_median_model_metrics, by = c("outcome" = "outcome", "model" = "model")) |> 
  select(-c(6:15)) |> 
  unique() |> 
  # Remove NA features that the model didn't use - none tho
  filter(!is.na(mean_abs_SHAP)) |> 
  mutate(
    Feature_type = case_when(
      feature %in% colnames(combined_patient_mdata_v5) ~ "Clinical",
      TRUE ~ "Bacterial genomic"
      )
    ) |>
  mutate(Feature_type = factor(Feature_type, levels = c("Clinical", "Bacterial genomic"))) #  |> 
  # Convert SHAP 0 to 10e-6 so I can log transform for plotting
  mutate(mean_abs_SHAP = ifelse(mean_abs_SHAP == 0, 10e-6, mean_abs_SHAP))

# Get minimum for overall trends
long_SHAP_results_type_min <- long_SHAP_results_type |> 
  group_by(outcome, Feature_type) |> 
  summarise(
    feature_count = n(),
    outcome_mean_abs_SHAP = mean(mean_abs_SHAP)
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Feature_type", values_from = c("feature_count", "outcome_mean_abs_SHAP"), values_fill = 0) |> 
  left_join(class_imbalance_data, by = "outcome") |> 
  left_join(best_median_model_metrics_v2, by = "outcome") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(9:10), names_to = "Proportion_measured", values_to = "Proportion") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(23, 19, 21), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Metric_accuracy") |> 
  mutate(
    Metric = case_when(
      Metric == "median_balanced_accuracy" ~ "Median Balanced accuracy",
      # Metric == "median_F1" ~ "Median F1-score",
      Metric == "median_sensitivity" ~ "Median sensitivity",
      Metric == "median_specificity" ~ "Median specificity"
    ),
    Proportion_measured = case_when(
      Proportion_measured == "positive_class_ratio" ~ "Positive class proportion",
      Proportion_measured == "prop_patients_with_outcome_data" ~ "Proportion of patients with data",
      TRUE ~ Proportion_measured
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Proportion_measured = factor(Proportion_measured, levels = c("Proportion of patients with data", "Positive class proportion")),
  )

# V2 for plotting col
long_SHAP_results_type_v2 <- long_SHAP_results_type |> 
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = model_scores_x_axis_order)
    ) |> 
  arrange(outcome) |> 
  complete(
    outcome,
    Feature_type,
    fill = list(mean_abs_SHAP = NA)
  ) |> 
  unique()


# Perform stats on this df

# First check shape
shape_check_SHAP <- long_SHAP_results_type_v2 |> 
  group_by(outcome, Feature_type) |> 
  summarise(
    skewness = skewness(mean_abs_SHAP),
    kurtosis = kurtosis(mean_abs_SHAP),
    variance = var(mean_abs_SHAP)
  )

# ooh yeah, I need non-parametric tests. Given the larger n this time, I can use Brunner-Munzel test still - unequal n between groups!
mean_abs_shap_bm_test <- long_SHAP_results_type_v2 |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  group_modify(~ {

    # Require exactly 2 groups
    groups <- unique(.x$Feature_type)
    if (length(groups) != 2) {
      return(tibble(
        .y. = "mean_abs_SHAP",
        group1 = NA_character_,
        group2 = NA_character_,
        p = NA_real_,
        p.adj = NA_real_,
        p.format = NA_character_,
        p.signif = NA_character_,
        method = "Insufficient groups"
      ))
    }

    # Check minimum n
    group_counts <- table(.x$Feature_type)
    if (any(group_counts < 2)) {
      return(tibble(
        .y. = "mean_abs_SHAP",
        group1 = groups[1],
        group2 = groups[2],
        p = NA_real_,
        p.adj = NA_real_,
        p.format = NA_character_,
        p.signif = NA_character_,
        method = paste("Small n:", paste(group_counts, collapse = ", "))
      ))
    }

    # Brunner–Munzel test
    bm_test <- brunnermunzel.test(
      mean_abs_SHAP ~ Feature_type,
      data = .x,
      perm = FALSE
    )

    tibble(
      .y. = "mean_abs_SHAP",
      group1 = groups[1],
      group2 = groups[2],
      p = bm_test$p.value,
      method = bm_test$method,
      statistic = bm_test$statistic,
      p.value = bm_test$p.value,
      estimate = bm_test$estimate,
      conf.int_low = bm_test$conf.int[1],
      conf.int_high = bm_test$conf.int[2]
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Should calculate p-value adjustment with Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) given the permuted BM test
  mutate(
    p.adj.bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    p.adj.bh_label = symnum(
      p.adj.bh,
      cutpoints = c(0, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 5e-2, 1),
      symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")
      ) )
  # ) |> 
  # select(group1, group2, `p.adj.bh`, `.y.`, outcome, 6:13)

y_pos <- long_SHAP_results_type_v2 |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  summarise(
    y.position = max(mean_abs_SHAP, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
mean_abs_shap_bm_test2 <- mean_abs_shap_bm_test |>
  left_join(y_pos, by = "outcome") |> 
  relocate(y.position, .after = p.adj.bh) |> 
  mutate(p.adj.bh_label2 = ifelse(p.adj.bh_label == "ns", "ns", NA_character_))

# Get feature type counts for col graph

  mutate(
```

```{r Look at immunocompromised people}
vir_filt_long_SHAP <- long_SHAP |> 
  # Only keep best models from round 4
  filter(
    outcome == "Mortality" & model == "CatBoost" |
    outcome == "Sepsis" & model == "LightGBM" |
    outcome == "Poor prognosis" & model == "LightGBM"
    ) |> 
  # Now look at canonical virulence factors
  # filter(feature == "RmpADC_presence")

write_tsv(vir_filt_long_SHAP, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/vir_filt_long_SHAP.tsv")

# test <- long_SHAP |>

#   select(feature, Feature_type) |> 
#   unique()

# Longerise feature values - numeric only as can't combine with cat cols
long_feature_numeric <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |>
  select(PopPUNK_cluster, Infecting_isolate, where(is.numeric)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_num"
  )

# Now do cat cols
long_feature_cat <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |>
  select(
    PopPUNK_cluster,
    Infecting_isolate,
    where(is.character),
    where(is.factor)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PopPUNK_cluster, Infecting_isolate),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "feature_value_cat"
  )

# Combine
long_features <- full_join(
  long_feature_numeric,
  long_feature_cat,
  by = c("PopPUNK_cluster", "Infecting_isolate", "feature")
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_value = coalesce(
      as.character(feature_value_cat),
      as.character(feature_value_num)
    )
  )


# Now join feature values with feature SHAP
long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP <- vir_filt_long_SHAP |>
  left_join(
    long_features,
    by = c(
      "Infecting_isolate" = "Infecting_isolate",
      "PopPUNK_cluster_label" = "PopPUNK_cluster",
      "feature" = "feature"
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(signed_SHAP)
  )

# Determine feature type for handling
long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full <- long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    feature_value_type = case_when(
      # Binary numeric
      all(feature_value_num %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE) == 2 ~ "binary",

      # Constant binary (important!)
      all(feature_value_num %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value_num, na.rm = TRUE) == 1 ~ "binary_constant",

      # Categorical
      all(is.na(feature_value_num)) ~ "categorical",

      # Continuous
      TRUE ~ "continuous"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  right_join(long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP, by = "feature")
write_tsv(long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full.tsv")


# Now let's look at youngins and immunocompromised and see what the virulence has to say about that

immuno_and_young <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Immunodeficiency, Age_years) |>
  mutate(patient_status = case_when(
    Immunodeficiency == 1 & Age_years < 70 ~ "Immunodeficient below age 70",
    Immunodeficiency == 1 & Age_years >= 70 ~ "Immunodeficient above age 70",
    is.na(Immunodeficiency) & Age_years >= 70 ~ "Immune status unknown, above age 70",
    is.na(Immunodeficiency) & Age_years < 70 ~ "Immune status unknown, below age 70",
    Immunodeficiency == 0 & Age_years < 70 ~ "Immunocompetent below age 70",
    Immunodeficiency == 0 & Age_years >= 70 ~ "Immunocompetent above age 70",
    TRUE ~ "AAAA"
    )
  ) |> 
  right_join(long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(Age_years),
    !is.na(Immunodeficiency)
    )
unique(immuno_and_young$patient_status)

# Let's just look at presence
immuno_and_young_pres <- immuno_and_young |> 
  filter(
    feature %in% c("Yersiniabactin_presence", "Colibactin_presence", "Aerobactin_presence", "Salmochelin_presence", "RmpADC_presence", "rmpA2_presence"),
    !is.na(feature_value)
  )
  # filter(str_detect(feature, "_presence$") | feature %in% c("peg-344"))

immuno_vir_pres_SHAP_point <- ggplot(immuno_and_young_pres, aes(x = feature_value, y = signed_SHAP)) +

immuno_vir_trunc_SHAP_point <- ggplot(immuno_and_young_trunc, aes(x = feature_value, y = signed_SHAP)) +
```

```{r Fig. 3D - top 10 features per outcome}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)
library(tidytext)
library(ggridges)


### Load data

# Long table of all features and values
long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3.tsv")

# Full summarise
grouped_SHAPs <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  # Calculate mean absolute SHAP per feature-outcome
  group_by(outcome, feature) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP)),
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP),
    min_SHAP = min(signed_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  # Identify top 10 features per outcome
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_rank = dense_rank(-mean_abs_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 <- write_tsv(grouped_SHAPs, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/grouped_SHAPs.tsv")

platelet <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  filter(feature %in% c("Platelet_count", "Eosinophil_count", "Serum_C_Reactive_Protein_mg_L", "Procalcitonin") & outcome == "Sepsis") |> 
  filter(feature == "Procalcitonin")
ggplot(platelet, aes(x = feature_value_num, y = signed_SHAP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )


# Get top 10 features for a scatterplot
grouped_SHAPs_mut <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  # Calculate mean absolute SHAP per feature-outcome
  group_by(outcome, feature) |> 
  mutate(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP)),
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP),
    min_SHAP = min(signed_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  # Identify top 10 features per outcome
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_rank = dense_rank(-mean_abs_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

grouped_SHAP_top10 <- grouped_SHAPs_mut |> 
  # Filter to keep only top 10 features
  filter(feature_rank <= 10) |> 
  # tidytext to reorder axes per facet
  mutate(feature_reordered = reorder_within(feature, -min_SHAP, within = outcome))

# Tidy up top10 before 
grouped_SHAP_top10_distribution <- grouped_SHAP_top10 |> 
  mutate(feature = str_replace_all(feature, "_", " ")) |>
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    feature == "Age years" ~ "Age (years)",
    feature == "Fibrinogen Degradation Products" ~ "Fibrinogen degradation products",
    feature == "Na sodium" ~ "Na (sodium)",
    feature == "Thrombin Time" ~ "Thrombin time",
    feature == "Prothrombin Time" ~ "Prothrombin time",
    feature == "Red Blood Cell count" ~ "Red blood cell count",
    feature == "D Dimer" ~ "D-dimer",
    feature == "Serum C Reactive Protein mg L" ~ "Serum C Reactive Protein",
    feature == "Red Cell Distribution Width SD" ~ "Red Cell DW-SD",
    feature == "Platelet Distribution Width" ~ "Platelet DW",
    feature == "Fibrinogen degradation products" ~ "Fibrinogen DPs",
    feature == "Blood pressure diastolic" ~ "Diastolic BP",
    feature == "Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter Arterial Venous Catheter" ~ "Central venous catheter",
    feature == "Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time" ~ "Partial thromboplastin time",
    feature == "Creatine Kinase Isoenzymes" ~ "Creatine Kinase",
    feature == "Cerebrovascular disease incl neurological disease" ~ "Cerebrovascular disease",
    str_detect(feature, " avg ") ~ str_replace(feature, " avg ", " "),
    TRUE ~ feature
  )
  ) |> 
  # tidytext to reorder axes per facet
  mutate(feature_reordered = reorder_within(feature, min_SHAP, within = outcome)) |> 
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Poor prognosis", "Mortality", "Sepsis", "Septic shock", "Respiratory support", "Vasoactive use", "Initial treatment failure", "Readmission", "Reinfection"))) |> 
  filter(outcome %in% c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Sepsis"))


top_10_features_ridge <- ggplot(grouped_SHAP_top10_distribution, aes(x = signed_SHAP, y = feature_reordered, group = feature_reordered, height = after_stat(ndensity))) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(fill = Feature_type), alpha = 0.8, scale = 1, rel_min_height = 0.001, linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_discrete_diverging(name = "Feature type", palette = "Blue-Red", rev = FALSE) +
  scale_y_reordered(expand = c(0, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05)) +
  labs(
    x = "Signed SHAP value within feature",
    y = "Top features for each outcome"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#482370", linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  )
top_10_features_ridge
Fig_3D <- top_10_features_ridge
ggsave(file="ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/top_10_features_ridge.png", plot=top_10_features_ridge, width=12, height=6.5)
ggsave(file="ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/top_10_features_ridge.png", plot=top_10_features_ridge, width=12, height=6.5)

# Join to Fig 3

Fig_3ABCD
```

```{r v1 round of ML, looking at truncation of any ybt genes}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)
library(tidytext)
library(ggpubr)

### Load data

# Long table of all features and values
long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/output/long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full.tsv")

combined_contig_reports <- read_tsv("plasmids/combined_contig_reports.tsv")

genome_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v5.tsv")

combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")


### Manip

combined_patient_mdata_v5_min <- combined_patient_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Mortality_binary)


genome_mdata_v5_min <- genome_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Specimen, Sublineage)

ybt_trunc_analy_0.5 <- long_vir_feature_values_and_SHAP_full |> 
  filter(
    feature %in% c(
      "irp1_trunc_status",
      "irp2_trunc_status",
      "ybtA_trunc_status",
      "ybtE_trunc_status",
      "ybtP_trunc_status",
      "ybtQ_trunc_status",
      "ybtS_trunc_status",
      "ybtT_trunc_status",
      "ybtU_trunc_status",
      "ybtX_trunc_status",
      "fyuA_trunc_status"
      ),
    !is.na(feature_value_cat)
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    feature = str_replace_all(feature, "_trunc_status", " truncation status"),
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_cat = ifelse(feature_value_cat == "Partial gene loss or IS interruption", "Interruption", feature_value_cat)
  ) |> 
  left_join(genome_mdata_v5_min, by = "Infecting_isolate")

ybt_trunc_analy <- ybt_trunc_analy_0.5 |> 
  group_by(feature, feature_value_cat) |> 
  mutate(
    median = round(median(signed_SHAP), 2),
    IQR = round(IQR(signed_SHAP), 2),
    mean = round(mean(signed_SHAP), 2),
    sd = round(sd(signed_SHAP), 2)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()


ybt_trunc_analy_min <- ybt_trunc_analy |> 
  filter(outcome == "Mortality") |> 
  select(1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 13) |> 
  left_join(combined_patient_mdata_v5_min, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  filter(feature_value_cat != "Absent") |> 
  mutate(Truncation_simple = ifelse(feature_value_cat %in% c("Intact"), "Intact", "Truncated")) |> 
  # Remove cases where only Intact or Truncated appear (no comparator)
  group_by(feature) |> 
  filter(n_distinct(Truncation_simple) == 2) |>
  ungroup()


library(logistf)
unique(ybt_trunc_analy_min$Truncation_simple)
unique(ybt_trunc_analy_min$feature)
levels(factor(ybt_trunc_analy_min$Truncation_simple))
firths_trunc_log_reg <- ybt_trunc_analy_min |> 
  group_by(feature) |> 
  reframe({
    # Fit the model for the current group
    fit <- logistf(Mortality_binary ~ Truncation_simple, data = pick(everything()))
    
    # Return a tibble of the statistics for this group
    tibble(
      OR       = exp(coef(fit)[2]),
      lower_95 = exp(fit$ci.lower[2]),
      upper_95 = exp(fit$ci.upper[2]),
      p_value  = fit$prob[2]
    )
  })

# Perform Firth’s bias-reduced logistic regression - irp1 + other features using firths
firths_trunc_fit <- ybt_trunc_analy_min |> 
  group_by(feature) |> 
  logistf(Mortality_binary ~ Truncation_simple, data = .)
firths_trunc_log_reg <- tibble(
  OR = exp(coef(firths_trunc_fit)[2]),
  lower_95 = exp(firths_trunc_fit$ci.lower[2]),
  upper_95 = exp(firths_trunc_fit$ci.upper[2]),
  p_value = firths_trunc_fit$prob[2]
)
names(coef(firths_trunc_fit))


```

```{r Prediction tsv input example df}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)

### Load data

# full dataset SHAP values for example df
combined_SHAP_report <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/combined_SHAP_report.tsv")



### Functions

# Function to generate fake patient example data
fake_rows <- function(df, n = 3, noise_frac = 0.05) {

  as_tibble(
    lapply(df, function(x) {

      # Numeric
      if (is.numeric(x)) {

        vals <- na.omit(x)

        # Binary numeric (0/1, 1/2, etc.)
        if (length(unique(vals)) == 2) {

          sample(vals, n, replace = TRUE)

        # Integer-valued
        } else if (all(vals %% 1 == 0)) {

          out <- sample(vals, n, replace = TRUE)

          # Add small noise then round back to integers
          out <- round(out + rnorm(n, 0, sd(vals) * noise_frac))

          # Keep within observed range
          pmin(max(vals), pmax(min(vals), out))

        # Continuous
        } else {

          out <- sample(vals, n, replace = TRUE) +
            rnorm(n, 0, sd(vals) * noise_frac)
          
          out <- pmin(max(vals), pmax(min(vals), out))
          
          round(out, 1)
          # out <- sample(vals, n, replace = TRUE) +
          #   rnorm(n, 0, sd(vals) * noise_frac)
          # 
          # # Keep within observed range
          # pmin(max(vals), pmax(min(vals), out))
        }

      # Logical
      } else if (is.logical(x)) {

        sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n, replace = TRUE)

      # Factor
      } else if (is.factor(x)) {

        factor(
          sample(levels(x), n, replace = TRUE),
          levels = levels(x)
        )

      # Character
      } else if (is.character(x)) {

        sample(unique(na.omit(x)), n, replace = TRUE)

      } else {

        rep(NA, n)

      }

    })
  )

}
```

```{r Table 1 clinical information summary}
combined_patient_mdata_v5_fix <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5_fix.tsv") 

### Manip

country_count <- combined_patient_mdata_v5_fix |> 
  group_by(Country) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

# Get numeric data
Table_1_clin_numeric <- combined_patient_mdata_v5_fix |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Country, where(is.numeric)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(3:last_col()), names_to = "feature", values_to = "feature_value") |> 
  filter(!is.na(feature_value)) |> 
  group_by(feature, Country) |>
  mutate(
    feature_value_type = case_when(
      # Binary numeric
      all(feature_value %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value, na.rm = TRUE) == 2 ~ "binary",

      # Constant binary (important!)
      all(feature_value %in% c(0, 1, NA)) &
        n_distinct(feature_value, na.rm = TRUE) == 1 ~ "binary_constant",

      # Categorical
      all(is.na(feature_value)) ~ "categorical",

      # Continuous
      TRUE ~ "continuous"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

Table_1_clin_cont <- Table_1_clin_numeric |> 
  filter(feature_value_type == "continuous") |> 
  group_by(feature, Country, feature_value_type) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(feature_value),
    iqr = IQR(feature_value),
    n = n()
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("feature", "feature_value_type"), names_from = "Country", values_from = c(4:6)) |> 
  select(1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 3, 5, 7)
```

```{r Fig. 4 - signed SHAP}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)
library(tidytext)
library(ggpubr)


### Load data

# # SHAP features - binned results
# binned_SHAP_per_feature_value <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/binned_SHAP_per_feature_value.tsv")

# Long table of all features and values
long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3.tsv")


### Manip


# Practise on mortality
mortality_signed_shap <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |>
  # Keep only Mortality and NA features
  filter(
    outcome == "Mortality",
    model == "CatBoost"
  ) |> 
  group_by(outcome, feature) |> 
  mutate(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP))
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_rank = dense_rank(-mean_abs_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(feature_rank <= 14 ) |> # | feature == "Omp_mutations"
  mutate(feature = str_replace_all(feature, "_", " ")) |> 
  # Simplify long feature names
  group_by(feature) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_alt = case_when(
      feature_value == "Absent" ~ "Absent",
      feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" ~
        paste0(
          "profile_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value, levels = unique(feature_value)))
        ),

      # feature == "Omp mutations" ~
      #   paste0(
      #     "profile_",
      #     dense_rank(factor(feature_value, levels = unique(feature_value)))
      #   ),

      feature_value == "0" ~ "No",
      feature_value == "1" ~ "Yes",

      TRUE ~ as.character(feature_value)
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

cipro_profiles <- mortality_signed_shap |> 
  filter(feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile") |> 
  select(feature_value_alt, feature_value_cat) |> 
  unique()

mortality_signed_shap_cont <- mortality_signed_shap |> 
  filter(
    feature_value_type %in% c("continuous")) |> 
  mutate(feature_value = as.numeric(feature_value))

mortality_signed_shap_cat <- mortality_signed_shap |> 
  filter(feature_value_type == "categorical") |> 
  # group_by(feature) |> 
  # arrange(feature, feature_value, .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  # ungroup() |> 
  group_by(feature, feature_value) |> 
  mutate(mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(feature_reordered = reorder_within(feature, -signed_SHAP, within = outcome)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(feature_value)) |> 
  # Fix profiles to be clear what is S/I/R
  mutate(feature_value_alt = case_when(
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_1" ~ "profile_1 (R)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_2" ~ "profile_2 (R)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_3" ~ "profile_3 (S)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_4" ~ "profile_4 (I)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_5" ~ "profile_5 (R)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_6" ~ "profile_6 (R)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_7" ~ "profile_7 (S)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_8" ~ "profile_8 (R)",
    feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" & feature_value_alt == "profile_9" ~ "profile_9 (R)",
    TRUE ~ feature_value_alt
    )
  ) |>
  # title of acquired carbs for facet
  mutate(feature = ifelse(feature == "Bla Carb acquired", "Acquired carbapenemase", feature))

mortality_signed_shap_bin <- mortality_signed_shap |> 
  filter(
    feature_value_type %in% c("binary") | feature == "Immunodeficiency",
    !is.na(feature_value),
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_alt = ifelse(feature_value_alt == "2", "Yes", feature_value_alt),
    feature_value = as.numeric(feature_value)
    )

mortality_signed_shap_use <- mortality_signed_shap |> 
  # filter(
  #   feature %in% c(
  #     "Bla_Carb_acquired",
  #     "Omp_mutations",
  #     "unitig_13048_avg_abundance",
  #     "ICU_admission",
  #     "Initial_treatment_failure",
  #     "Sepsis",
  #     "Septic_shock",
  #     "Central_venous_catheter",
  #     "Age_years",
  #     "APACHE_II_score",
  #     "Charlson_index",
  #     "D_Dimer",
  #     "Fibrinogen_Degradation_Products",
  #     "Glucose",
  #     "Hemoglobin",
  #     "Immunodeficiency",
  #     "Lymphocyte",
  #     "Na_sodium",
  #     "Neutrophil_count",
  #     "Platelet_count",
  #     "Red_Blood_Cell_count",
  #     "Prothrombin_Time",
  #     "Thrombin_Time",
  #     "Urea",
  #     "peg-344_allele"
  #   )
  # ) |>
  filter(
    feature %in% c(
      "Age_years",
      "Red_Blood_Cell_count",
      "Fibrinogen_Degradation_Products",
      "Neutrophil_count",
      "Bla_Carb_acquired",
      "Omp_mutations",
      "peg-344_allele",
      "unitig_13048_avg_abundance",
      "ICU_admission",
      "Septic_shock",
      "Immunodeficiency",
      "Initial_treatment_failure"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(feature = str_replace_all(feature, "_", " ")) |>
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    feature == "Age years" ~ "Age (years)",
    feature == "Fibrinogen Degradation Products" ~ "Fibrinogen degradation products",
    feature == "Na sodium" ~ "Na (sodium)",
    feature == "Thrombin Time" ~ "Thrombin time",
    feature == "Prothrombin Time" ~ "Prothrombin time",
    feature == "Red Blood Cell count" ~ "Red blood cell count",
    feature == "D Dimer" ~ "D-dimer",
    feature == "Bla Carb acquired" ~ "Acquired carbapenemase",
    TRUE ~ feature
  )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_binned = str_replace_all(
      as.character(feature_value_binned),
      c(
        "e\\+03" = "000",
        "e\\+02" = "00"
      )
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(feature) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_binned_alt_name = case_when(
      feature_value_binned == "Absent" ~ "Absent",
      feature == "peg-344 allele" ~
        paste0(
          "allele_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned)))
        ),

      feature == "Omp mutations" ~
        paste0(
          "profile_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned)))
        ),

      feature_value_binned == "0" ~ "No",
      feature_value_binned == "1" ~ "Yes",

      TRUE ~ as.character(feature_value_binned)
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Order based on bin values...
  mutate(feature_value_binned_alt_name = factor(feature_value_binned_alt_name, levels = str_sort(unique(feature_value_binned_alt_name), numeric = TRUE))) |> 
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = c(
    "Age (years)",
    "Red blood cell count",
    "Fibrinogen degradation products",
    "Neutrophil count",
    "Acquired carbapenemase",
    "Omp mutations",
    "peg-344 allele",
    "unitig 13048 avg abundance",
    "Immunodeficiency",
    "Septic shock",
    "ICU admission",
    "Initial treatment failure"
    )
  )
  )
```

```{r Fig 6}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)

# Long table of all features and values

### Manip dfs

  summarise(mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(signed_SHAP))) |>

# Get top 50 features so I can extract the unitigs/genetic features
top_50_features <- long_SHAP |> 
  group_by(outcome, feature, Feature_type) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(signed_SHAP)),
    mean_shap = mean(signed_SHAP)
    ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mean_shap)) |> 
  group_by(outcome) |> 
  # Calculate rank for top features for later?
  mutate(rank = rank(desc(mean_shap))) |> 
  ungroup()

# Genomic features
top_genomic_features <- top_50_features |> 
  filter(Feature_type == "Bacterial genomic")

# Okay now get individual features and their signed SHAPs
genomic_feature_SHAPs <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(signed_SHAP),  
    Feature_type == "Bacterial genomic"
  ) |> 
  mutate(feature_value_binned = str_replace(feature_value_binned, "\\[", "(")) |> 
  mutate(feature = str_replace_all(feature, "_", " ")) |>
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    feature == "Age years" ~ "Age (years)",
    feature == "Fibrinogen Degradation Products" ~ "Fibrinogen degradation products",
    feature == "Na sodium" ~ "Na (sodium)",
    feature == "Thrombin Time" ~ "Thrombin time",
    feature == "Prothrombin Time" ~ "Prothrombin time",
    feature == "Red Blood Cell count" ~ "Red blood cell count",
    feature == "D Dimer" ~ "D-dimer",
    feature == "Bla Carb acquired" ~ "Acquired carbapenemase",
    TRUE ~ feature
  )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_binned = str_replace_all(
      as.character(feature_value_binned),
      c(
        "e\\+03" = "000",
        "e\\+02" = "00"
      )
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(feature) |> 
  mutate(
    feature_value_binned_alt_name = case_when(
      feature_value_binned == "Absent" ~ "Absent",
      feature == "peg-344 allele" ~
        paste0(
          "allele_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned)))
        ),

      feature == "Omp mutations" ~
        paste0(
          "profile_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned)))
        ),
      
      feature == "Ciprofloxacin profile" ~
        paste0(
          "profile_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned))) 
        ),

      feature == "spurious resistance hits" ~
        paste0(
          "profile_",
          dense_rank(factor(feature_value_binned, levels = unique(feature_value_binned))) 
        ),

      feature_value_binned == "0" ~ "No",
      feature_value_binned == "1" ~ "Yes",

      TRUE ~ as.character(feature_value_binned)
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Order based on bin values...
  mutate(feature_value_binned_alt_name = factor(feature_value_binned_alt_name, levels = str_sort(unique(feature_value_binned_alt_name), numeric = TRUE)))
write_tsv(genomic_feature_SHAPs, "ML_predictions/v4_final/output/genomic_features/genomic_feature_SHAPs.tsv")
```

```{r unitig pullout}
# Get list of unitigs to filter df
important_unitigs <- read_lines("ML_predictions/v4_final/output/genomic_features/important_unitigs.txt")

# Input genomic matrix
genome_mdata_v4 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v4.tsv")


### Manip

# Filter the df to reduce size
key_genomes_unitigs <- genome_mdata_v4 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, all_of((important_unitigs)))

# Pivot longer for manipulation and remove abundance = 0
long_key_genome_unitigs <- key_genomes_unitigs |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:last_col()), names_to = "unitig", values_to = "avg_abundance") |> 
  filter(avg_abundance >= 1)

# Generate a set list of all unitigs per genome
genome_sets <- long_key_genome_unitigs |>
  group_by(Infecting_isolate) |>
  summarise(unitigs = list(unique(unitig)), .groups = "drop")

# Use greedy set cover to find the fewest numbner of genomes - I don't want to annotate EVERYTHING
covered <- character()
minimal_genomes <- character()

while (length(setdiff(important_unitigs, covered)) > 0) {

  best <- genome_sets |>
    mutate(
      new_coverage = purrr::map_int(
        unitigs,
        ~ length(setdiff(.x, covered))
      )
    ) |>
    filter(new_coverage == max(new_coverage)) |>
    slice(1)

  minimal_genomes <- c(minimal_genomes, best$Infecting_isolate)
  covered <- union(covered, best$unitigs[[1]])

  genome_sets <- genome_sets |>
    filter(Infecting_isolate != best$Infecting_isolate)
}

# List of genomes
minimal_genomes
# [1] "21P1044" "21P754"  "21P1308" "AN-51"   "21P1238" "21P727"  "PE25966"
length(minimal_genomes)

# Filter dataframe on these minimal genomes
minimal_genomes_unitigs <- long_key_genome_unitigs |> 
  filter(Infecting_isolate %in% minimal_genomes)

# Confirm this list matches the input list
setdiff(important_unitigs, unique(minimal_genomes_unitigs$unitig))
setdiff(unique(minimal_genomes_unitigs$unitig), important_unitigs)

# woot, only annotating 6 genomes!
write_lines(minimal_genomes, "unitig/annotated_genomes/minimal_genomes.txt")

```

```{r Fig. 6 - Analysing unitigs}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(plasmapR)
library(ggh4x)
library(colorspace)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggfittext)
library(stringr)
library(ggpmisc)
library(scales)

### Load data

# Unitig hits from blast
combined_unitig_blast_results <- read_tsv("unitig/mapping_unitigs/blast_results/combined_unitig_blast_results.tsv")

# Annotations from Bakta
combined_annotations <- read_tsv("unitig/mapping_unitigs/blast_results/combined_annotations.tsv")

# Contig info
combined_contig_reports <- read_tsv("plasmids/combined_contig_reports.tsv")

# SHAP info
mean_genomic_SHAPs_signed_filt_relationships <- read_tsv("unitig/annotated_genomes/mean_genomic_SHAPs_signed_filt_relationships.tsv")

# Full unitig list rather than reduced to 20
# mean_genomic_SHAPs_signed <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/old/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_1/v4_final/output/genomic_features/mean_genomic_SHAPs_signed.tsv")

long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3.tsv")


### Manip

# Rank top features again
top_features <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  filter(
    outcome %in% c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Sepsis")
  ) |> 
  group_by(outcome, model, Feature_type, feature) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP)),
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP)
  ) |>
  group_by(outcome, model) |> 
  mutate(rank = dplyr::dense_rank(-mean_abs_SHAP)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(
    str_detect(feature, "unitig")
    )


# Simplify SHAPs
SHAP_feature_cont_value_means <- long_feature_values_and_SHAP_v3 |> 
  filter(!is.na(feature_value_num)) |> 
  group_by(outcome, model, Feature_type, feature, feature_value_num) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(signed_SHAP)),
    mean_signed_SHAP = mean(signed_SHAP)
  ) |> 
  # Now define as outcome associated or non, based on R2 values from Fig. S8
  mutate(
    relationship_with_outcome = case_when(
      outcome == "Mortality" & feature == "unitig_10499_avg_abundance" ~ "Outcome associated (strong)",
      outcome == "Mortality" & feature == "unitig_13155_avg_abundance" ~ "Outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Poor prognosis" & feature == "unitig_17566_avg_abundance" ~ "Outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Poor prognosis" & feature == "unitig_25011_avg_abundance" ~ "Non-outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Poor prognosis" & feature == "unitig_4038_avg_abundance" ~ "No relationship",
      outcome == "Poor prognosis" & feature == "unitig_5454_avg_abundance" ~ "Non-outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Sepsis" & feature == "unitig_12658_avg_abundance" ~ "Outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Sepsis" & feature == "unitig_21668_avg_abundance" ~ "Outcome associated (moderate)",
      outcome == "Sepsis" & feature == "unitig_724_avg_abundance" ~ "Non-outcome associated (moderate)",
      TRUE ~ "AAAAA - To do still"
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
write_tsv(SHAP_feature_cont_value_means, "ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v4/output/SHAP_feature_cont_value_means.tsv")

# Let's write a 1 unitig per row output
unitig_breakdown_9 <- SHAP_feature_cont_value_means |> 
  select(1, 2, 4, 8) |> 
  filter(
    str_detect(feature, "unitig"),
    !str_detect(relationship_with_outcome, "AAAAA")
    ) |> 
  unique() |> 
  mutate(
    unitig = str_remove(feature, "_avg_abundance"),
    unitig = str_remove(unitig, "unitig_")
  )

hits_to_annotations <- combined_unitig_blast_results |> 
  left_join(combined_annotations, by = c("filename" = "Filename", "sseqid" = "Sequence_id"))

# Now I need to calculate the distance of the sstart and send to the Start and Stop and determine if intergenic or within gene
hits_to_annotations_v2 <- hits_to_annotations |> 
  # First I need the pmins and pmaxes for determining overlaps...
  mutate(
    hit_start = pmin(sstart, send),
    hit_end = pmax(sstart, send),
    gene_start = pmin(Start, Stop),
    gene_end = pmax(Start, Stop)
  ) |> 
  # Now determine if inside gene or not based off the new gene ranges
  mutate(
    inside_gene = if_else(hit_start <= gene_end & hit_end >= gene_start, "Yes", "No")
  ) |> 
  # Arrange so I can use lag and lead to get previous and next flanking gene
  arrange(filename, qseqid, sseqid, gene_start) |> 
  group_by(filename, qseqid, sseqid, hit_start, hit_end) |>
  mutate(
    upstream_gene = lag(Gene),
    upstream_product = lag(Product),
    upstream_DbXrefs = lag(DbXrefs),
    downstream_gene = lead(Gene),
    downstream_product = lead(Product),
    downstream_DbXrefs = lag(DbXrefs),
    upstream_end = lag(gene_end),
    downstream_start = lead(gene_start)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    distance_upstream = case_when(
      inside_gene == "Yes" ~ 0,
      !is.na(upstream_end) ~ hit_start - upstream_end
    ),

    distance_downstream = case_when(
      inside_gene == "Yes" ~ 0,
      !is.na(downstream_start) ~ downstream_start - hit_end
    )
  )

# Now let's isolate unitigs which hit to genes
gene_hits <- hits_to_annotations_v2 |> 
  filter(inside_gene == "Yes" & !(str_detect(Product, "IS\\d") | str_detect(Product, "Transposase"))) |> 
  transmute(
      unitig = qseqid,
      genome = filename,
      genome_contig = sseqid,
      Locus_Tag,
      Gene,
      Product,
      DbXrefs,
      bitscore,
      inside_gene,
      hit_start,
      hit_end,
      gene_start,
      gene_end
      ) |>
  arrange(unitig, bitscore, Gene, Product) |> 
  group_by(unitig, Product) |> 
  mutate(most_common_product = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(unitig) |> 
  slice_max(most_common_product, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  select(-c(most_common_product, inside_gene)) |> 
  mutate(unitig_type = "Gene") |> 
  relocate(unitig_type, .after = unitig) |> 
  ungroup()
length(unique(gene_hits$unitig))
# 41, but 50 incl transposases
# length(unique(combined_unitig_blast_results$qseqid))
# 70 So I'm missing 20

# Let's grab intergenic unitig hits
intergenic_base <- hits_to_annotations_v2 |>
  # First remove hits that are already within genes
  filter(
    !qseqid %in% gene_hits$unitig
  )
length(unique(intergenic_base$qseqid))
# 29, or 20 without transposases - okay good, expected

# Now I need to filter this mess of a df
intergenic_hits <- intergenic_base |>
  # compute absolute distances to help identify closest genes so I can remove the others
  mutate(
    abs_upstream = abs(distance_upstream),
    abs_downstream = abs(distance_downstream)
  ) |>
  # for each unitig, pick the row with minimal distance
  group_by(qseqid) |>
  arrange(
    # first by minimal upstream distance, then minimal downstream distance, then bitscore
    abs_upstream,
    abs_downstream,
    desc(bitscore)
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>   # pick 1 representative row per unitig
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    unitig = qseqid,
    genome = filename,
    genome_contig = sseqid,
    Locus_Tag,
    Gene,
    Product,
    DbXrefs,
    upstream_gene,
    upstream_product,
    upstream_DbXrefs,
    hit_start,
    hit_end,
    downstream_gene,
    downstream_product,
    downstream_DbXrefs,
    distance_upstream,
    distance_downstream,
    bitscore
  ) |> 
  mutate(unitig_type = "Intergenic") |> 
  relocate(unitig_type, .after = unitig) |> 
  ungroup()
# length(unique(intergenic_hits$unitig))

# Combine within gene and intergenic hits
unitig_gene_hits <- bind_rows(gene_hits, intergenic_hits)

# Prep the contig reports before joining
propagated_contig_reports <- combined_contig_reports |>
  mutate(
    contig_id = str_replace(contig_id, " .*$", ""),
    contig_id = str_replace(contig_id, "^", "contig_")
    ) |> 
  mutate(across(3:last_col(), ~ ifelse(. == "-", NA_character_, .))) |>
  arrange(
    `rep_type(s)`,
    `relaxase_type(s)`,
    mpf_type,
    `orit_type(s)`,
    predicted_mobility, 
    repetitive_dna_type, 
    filtering_reason
  ) |>
  group_by(sample_id, primary_cluster_id, secondary_cluster_id) |> 
  fill(
    `rep_type(s)`,
    `relaxase_type(s)`,
    mpf_type,
    `orit_type(s)`,
    predicted_mobility, 
    repetitive_dna_type, 
    filtering_reason
    , .direction = "updown") |> 
  transmute(
    genome = sample_id,
    genome_contig = contig_id,
    molecule_type,
    primary_cluster_id,
    secondary_cluster_id,
    size,
    gc,
    rep_types = `rep_type(s)`,
    relaxase_types = `relaxase_type(s)`,
    mpf_type,
    orit_type = `orit_type(s)`,
    predicted_mobility,
    repetitive_dna_type,
    filtering_reason
  )

# Now merge contig report info as well
unitig_gene_hits_location <- unitig_gene_hits |> 
  left_join(propagated_contig_reports, by = c("genome" = "genome", "genome_contig" = "genome_contig")) |> 
  mutate(
    unitig = str_replace(unitig, "_", " "),
    unitig = ifelse(str_detect(unitig, "unitig"), str_replace(unitig, "$", " abundance"), unitig)
  ) |> 
  left_join(unitig_breakdown_9, by = c("unitig")) |> 
  filter(!is.na(outcome)) |> 
  mutate(
    Product = ifelse(is.na(Product), paste(unitig_type, "between", upstream_product, "and", downstream_product, sep = " "), Product)
  ) |> 
  rename(
    # name = Product,
    # type = relationship_with_outcome,
    start = hit_start,
    end = hit_end
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    molecule_type = ifelse(molecule_type == "plasmid", "Plasmid", "Chromosome"),
    direction = 1
  )|> 
  rowid_to_column("index") |> 
  relocate(index, .before = name) |> 
  mutate(
    molecule_type = case_when(
      genome == "PE20773" & genome_contig == "contig_12" ~ "Chromosome", 
      molecule_type == "Plasmid" ~ paste(rep_types, "plasmid", sep = " "),
      TRUE ~ molecule_type
    )
  )
write_tsv(unitig_gene_hits_location, "unitig/annotated_genomes/unitig_gene_hits_location.tsv")

  group_by(outcome, feature) |> 
  mutate(
    r = cor(feature_value_num, signed_SHAP, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    r.squared = r^2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    label = paste0("R² = ", signif(r.squared, 2))
  )
```

```{r Yersiniabactin stats for Chao}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Patient mdata
combined_patient_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v5.tsv")

# Full genomic data
genome_mdata_v5 <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v5.tsv")

yersiniabactin_df <- genome_mdata_v5 |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Sublineage, ST, Yersiniabactin) |> 
  group_by(Sublineage) |> 
  mutate(n_per_SL = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(Yersiniabactin_locus_pres = case_when(
    # str_detect(Yersiniabactin, "truncated") ~ "Truncated somewhere",
    str_detect(Yersiniabactin, "ybt") ~ "Present",
    is.na(Yersiniabactin) ~ "No genome",
    Yersiniabactin == "Absent" ~ "Absent",
    TRUE ~ "AAAA"
    )
  )


count_total_pres <- yersiniabactin_df |> 
  group_by(Yersiniabactin_locus_pres) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

yersiniabactin_df_filt <- yersiniabactin_df |> 
  filter(n_per_SL >= 10) |> 
  group_by(Sublineage, Yersiniabactin_locus_pres) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |> 
  filter(Yersiniabactin_locus_pres != "No genome") |> 
  group_by(Sublineage) |> 
  mutate(proportion_positive = count / sum(count) * 100) |> 
  mutate(proportion_positive = round(proportion_positive, 2)) |> 
  ungroup()

ggplot(yersiniabactin_df, aes(x = reorder(Sublineage, -count), y = count, fill = Yersiniabactin_locus_pres)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r blast results of unitigs back to genes}

## Blast results

combined_unitig_blast_results <- read_tsv("unitig/mapping_unitigs/blast_unitig_genes/combined_unitig_blast_results.tsv") |>
  mutate(unitig_10499 = ifelse(str_detect(sseq, "CAGGCGCAGAATGACCTGATGGCGTTGCTTGCCCGGAAGGAAATCAGCATTGTCA"), "Yes", "No")
  )

combined_unitig_blast_results_min <- combined_unitig_blast_results |> 
  select(1, 17)


merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/full_dataset_clin_and_genomic_pass_2/v1/input/merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1.tsv")

unitig_death_rate <- merged_patient_genome_feature_matrix_v1 |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(Mortality_binary),
    Specimen != "Other"
    ) |> 
  mutate(unitig_10499_VgrG = case_when(
    Infecting_isolate %in% unique(combined_unitig_blast_results$filename) ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) |> 
  left_join(combined_unitig_blast_results_min, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "filename")) |> 
  mutate(unitig_10499 = ifelse(is.na(unitig_10499), "No", unitig_10499))


library(logistf)
# Perform Firth’s bias-reduced logistic regression
firths_unitig_log_reg <- unitig_death_rate |>
  group_by(Specimen) |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(function(df) {

    if(nrow(df) < 50) return(NULL)

    fit <- logistf(Mortality_binary ~ unitig_10499_VgrG, data = df)

    tibble(
      Specimen = unique(df$Specimen),
      OR = exp(coef(fit)[2]),
      lower_95 = exp(fit$ci.lower[2]),
      upper_95 = exp(fit$ci.upper[2]),
      p_value = fit$prob[2]
    )
  })
```

```{r Standard stats of sublineage against outcomes}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(logistf)


### Load data

# Genome
genome_mdata <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_mdata_v4.tsv")

# Patient
patient_mdata <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v2.tsv")


### Manip

# Get minimal mdata
genome_mdata_min <- genome_mdata |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Sublineage, ST)

patient_mdata_min <- patient_mdata |> 
  select(Infecting_isolate, Vasoactive, Respiratory_support, Initial_treatment_failure, Reinfection, Readmission, Mortality_binary, Poor_prognosis_binary, Sepsis, Septic_shock)

# Merge together for stats
combined_stats_min_df <- genome_mdata_min |> 
  left_join(patient_mdata_min, by = "Infecting_isolate") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(4:12), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Outcome_binary")

count_per_overrep_SLs <- combined_stats_min_df |> 
  filter(
    Outcome == "Mortality_binary",
    !is.na(Outcome_binary),
    Sublineage %in% c("SL23", "SL15", "SL17", "SL29", "SL65", "SL412", "SL86", "SL307", "SL258", "SL37")
    ) |>
  select(-ST) |> 
  group_by(Sublineage, Outcome_binary) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |> 
  group_by(Sublineage) |> 
  mutate(percent_mortality = round(count / sum(count) * 100, 2)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(Outcome_binary == 1)
  

# Try GLM > Least-Squares Means
glm_emmeans_sublineages_outcomes <- map_dfr(outcome_list, function(outcome_name) {

  stats_df <- combined_stats_min_df %>%
    filter(
      Outcome == outcome_name,
      !is.na(Outcome_binary)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sublineage) %>%
    mutate(num_per_SL = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(num_per_SL >= 10)

  fit <- glm(
    Outcome_binary ~ Sublineage,
    family = binomial,
    data = stats_df
  )


  pairs(
    emmeans(fit, ~ Sublineage, type = "response"),
  ) |>
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(Outcome = outcome_name) |>
    mutate(p_adj_global = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"))
})
# Ah getting Inf degrees freedom (df). Need a new test - seperation issues as some have say, no Mortality

# Fit a Firth's Bias-Reduced Logistic Regression 0 as I kept getting Inf using glm and emmeans. map_dfr so I can apply my entire list in one function
firths_sublineages_outcomes <- map_dfr(outcome_list, function(outcome_name) {
  
  # Prepare the dataframe by removing NAs first then low n groups 
  stats_df <- combined_stats_min_df |> 
    filter(
      Outcome == outcome_name,
      !is.na(Outcome_binary)
    ) |> 
    group_by(Sublineage) |> 
    mutate(num_per_SL = n()) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    filter(num_per_SL >= 10) |> 
    mutate(Sublineage = factor(Sublineage))
  
  n_per_SL_df <- stats_df |> 
    select(Sublineage, num_per_SL) |> 
    unique()
  
  # Fit a Firths logistic regression 
  fit_firth <- logistf(
    Outcome_binary ~ Sublineage,
    data = stats_df
  )
  
  # Obtain the reference sublineage as this will be lost otherwise
  ref_SL <- levels(stats_df$Sublineage)[1]
  
  # Construct the tibble of the firth outcome data
  tibble(
    Outcome = outcome_name,
    Reference_sublineage = ref_SL,
    Sublineage = sub("^Sublineage", "", names(fit_firth$coefficients)[-1]),
    OR = exp(fit_firth$coefficients[-1]),
    # Need to exponentiate so I can make this meaningful with the OR
    lower.CL = exp(fit_firth$ci.lower[-1]),
    upper.CL = exp(fit_firth$ci.upper[-1]),
    p.value = fit_firth$prob[-1]
  ) |> 
    left_join(n_per_SL_df, by = c("Sublineage" = "Sublineage")) |> 
    rename(Sublineage_n = num_per_SL) |> 
    left_join(n_per_SL_df, by = c("Reference_sublineage" = "Sublineage")) |> 
    rename(Reference_sublineage_n = num_per_SL)

}) |> 
  # Filter NAs and then do Holm adjustment - global as I am doing many tests - most fair way to do this
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) |>
  mutate(p_adj_holm = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm")) |> 
  relocate(p_adj_holm, .after = p.value) |> 
  arrange(p_adj_holm)
write_tsv(firths_sublineages_outcomes, "Dataset/firths_sublineages_outcomes.tsv")
# Looking at this, OR > 1 is higher odds than reference while OR < 1 is lower odds than reference, SL29 has significantly lower chance of Poor prognosis than SL111 (OR 0.048, 95% CI 0.0046–0.2484, Holm-adjusted p = 0.012)"
	

)
```


```{r Feature selection signif differences for genomics only - v2 training results}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)
library(rstatix)


### Load data

# Results of catboost v2 training
v2_feature_selection_metrics <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/genomics_only/v2/output/v2_feature_selection_metrics.tsv")


### Manip dfs

# # Remove the averages from v2 results
all_targets_top_n_metrics <- v2_feature_selection_metrics |>
  select(c(1:5)) |> 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace_all(outcome, "_", " ")) |> 
  mutate(panel_group = interaction(outcome, model))

## Statistics to compare if there are any diffs between the feature counts in terms of AUC

# Kruskal test on genes to compare if genes
v2_feature_selection_metrics_kruskal <- compare_means(data = v2_feature_selection_metrics, auc ~ top_n_features, group.by = c("outcome", "model"), method = "kruskal.test", p.adjust.method = "holm") # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method  # method = "t.test", 'test =' instead of 'method =' # group.by = "group",

# None were significant - so no post hoc tests

# v2_feature_selection_metrics_dunns <- v2_feature_selection_metrics |> 
#   filter(outcome %in% c("Sepsis", "Septic_shock")) |> 
#   group_by(outcome, model) |>
#   dunn_test(auc ~ top_n_features, p.adjust.method = "holm") # from rstatix 


# Just one kruskal per plot...
n_feature_selection_30_mins <- ggplot(all_targets_top_n_metrics, 
             aes(x = as.factor(top_n_features), 
                 y = auc, 
                 fill = model,
                 group = interaction(as.factor(top_n_features), model))) +
  # Boxplots with dodge positioning
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),  # This creates side-by-side boxes
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    linewidth = 0.5, 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Jitter points with same dodge positioning
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_kruskal_test(
    label = "p = {p.adj}",
    # label = "KW with Holm, p = {p.adj}",
    p.adjust.method = "holm",
    geom = "text",
    group.by = "panel_group",
    label.y.npc = "bottom",
    label.x = 3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Model", values = c(
    "CatBoost" = "grey80",
    "LightGBM" = "grey20"
      )
    ) + 
  # scale_x_discrete(
  #   breaks = seq(10, 70, 10), 
  #   expand = c(0.075, 0.075)
  # ) +
  facet_grid(model ~ outcome) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of top-ranked features used for training",
    y = "AUC"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
n_feature_selection_30_mins
ggsave("ML_predictions/genomics_only/v2/output/n_feature_selection_30_mins.png", n_feature_selection_30_mins, width = 14, height = 5)
ggsave("ML_predictions/genomics_only/v2/output/n_feature_selection_30_mins.pdf", n_feature_selection_30_mins, width = 14, height = 5)

# Take the top median AUC
all_targets_top_n_median_exceptions <- all_targets_top_n_metrics |> 
  group_by(outcome, model, top_n_features) |> 
  summarise(median_auc = median(auc)) |> 
  group_by(outcome, model) |> 
  slice_max(median_auc, n = 1) |> 
  select(
    Top_n_features = top_n_features,
    Model = model,
    Outcome = outcome
  ) |> 
  mutate(Outcome = str_replace_all(Outcome, " ", "_"))
write_tsv(all_targets_top_n_median_exceptions, "ML_predictions/genomics_only/v3/input/all_targets_top_n_median_exceptions.tsv")
```

```{r Virulence rankings in round 1 of ML}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(colorspace)
library(tidytext)

### Load data

# Patient data raw
mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes_v1 <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/v1_initial/output/mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes_v1.tsv")


### Manip

prefixes <- c(
  "yb", "iro", "rmp", "rmst", "clb",
  "salmochelin", "yersiniabactin", "aerobactin", "colibactin",
  "rmpadc", "peg-344", "peg-589"
)


ranked_vir_features <- mean_abs_shap_all_outcomes_v1 |> 
  group_by(outcome, model) |> 
  mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(mean_abs_SHAP))) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(
    str_detect(
      tolower(feature),
      paste0("^(", paste(prefixes, collapse="|"), ")")
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(
    model == "CatBoost",
    rank <= 200
  ) |> 
  mutate(feature_reordered = reorder_within(feature, -mean_abs_SHAP, within = outcome))

ranked_vir_features_r1_model <- ggplot(ranked_vir_features, aes(x = feature_reordered, y = rank, fill = mean_abs_SHAP)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(name = "Mean absolute\nSHAP", palette = "Dark Mint") +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Feature importance rank"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, scales = "free") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
ranked_vir_features_r1_model
ggsave("ML_predictions/v1_initial/output/ranked_vir_features_r1_model.png", ranked_vir_features_r1_model, height = 10, width = 10)
```

```{r Metadata table}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# Patient data raw
patient_metadata_raw <- read_tsv("Dataset/patient_metadata/patient_metadata.txt")

# SRA metadata
sra_metadata <- read_tsv("Dataset/genome_metadata/sra_metadata.txt")

# Assembly stats
assembly_stats <- read_tsv("assemblies/assembly_fasta_stats_1177.tsv")

# Kleborate results
kleborate_results <- read_csv("Kleborate/kleborate.csv")

# Speciator
speciator_results <- read_csv("Kleborate/speciator.csv")

# LIN codes
lincodes <- read_csv("Kleborate/cgmlst_classification.csv")

# GFA stats
gfa_stats <- read_tsv("assemblies/gfa_stats.tsv")

# PopPUNK clusters
PP_clusters <- read_csv("PopPUNK/bgmm_model_fit_k_3_clusters.csv")

# SNP clusters
SNV_clusters <- read_tsv("kbo/time_weighted_SNV_clusters.tsv")

### Manip dfs

# Count SNV clusters
SNV_cluster_counts <- SNV_clusters |> 
  group_by(time_weighted_SNV_cluster) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

## Patient metadata

# Let's tidy the patient df up
patient_metadata_v1 <- patient_metadata_raw |> 
  # Fix weird cols
  mutate(
    Sex = case_when(
      `SEX(Female=2；male=1)` == 1 ~ "Male",
      `SEX(Female=2；male=1)` == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ "AAAAA"
      ),
    Age_years = case_when(
      Time_type == "days" ~ Time / 365,
      Time_type == "months" ~ Time / 12,
      Time_type == "years" ~ Time
      # TRUE ~ "9999"
    ),
    Specimen = case_when(
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 1 ~ "Respiratory",
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 2 ~ "Urogenital",
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 3 ~ "Bloodstream",
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 4 ~ "Abdominal",
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 5 ~ "Skin/soft tissue",
      `specimen（1=respiratory，2=Urogenital，3=bloodstream，4=abdominal，5=skin and soft tissue，6=others）` == 6 ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ "AAAAA"
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(Date = dmy(SPEC_DATE)) |> 
  select(1:2, 49:52, 6, 8, 10:48) |> 
  rename(
    "Charlson_index" = "Charlson-index",
    "Community_acquired_infection" = "CAI（community-acquired infection）",
    "Healthcare_associated_infection" = "HCAI",
    "Hospital_associated_infection" = "HAI",
    "Infecting_isolate" = "NCBI",
    "ICU_admission" = "ICU admission"
  ) |> 
  # Convert the acquired infection cols to 1 for binaries
  mutate(across(c(10:12), ~ ifelse(. >= 1, 1, .))) |> 
  # Summary col for aquisition
  mutate(Infection_aquisition = case_when(
    Community_acquired_infection == 1 ~ "Community",
    Healthcare_associated_infection == 1 ~ "Healthcare",
    Hospital_associated_infection == 1 ~ "Hospital",
    TRUE ~ "AAAAA"
  )
  ) |> 
  # Address mortality cols - 2 means lost to lost to follow-up so NA
  mutate(across(c(45:47), ~ ifelse(. == 2, NA, .))) |> 
  relocate(Infection_aquisition, .after = Specimen)
write_tsv(patient_metadata_v1, "Dataset/patient_metadata/patient_metadata_v1.tsv")


## Genome metadata

# Assembly stats rename stuff
assembly_stats_v2 <- assembly_stats |> 
  rename(
    contig_count = num_seqs
  ) |> 
  rename_with( ~str_replace_all(., "\\(\\%\\)", "_percent")) |> 
  rename_with( ~ paste0("Genome_", .x)) |> 
  rename(
    Genome = Genome_file
  )

# sra metadata cleaning
sra_metadata_v2 <- sra_metadata |> 
  select(-c(Bases, isolate, Library_Name, Collection_Date)) |> 
  rename(
    Host = HOST
  )

# Fix gfa stats
gfa_stats_v2 <- gfa_stats |> 
  select(1, 3, 5:7)

# Fix lincodes
lincodes_v2 <- lincodes |> 
  select(2, 5:8)

# Fix speciator
speciator_v2 <- speciator_results |> 
  select(2, 6, 7)

# Fix kleborate
kleborate_v2 <- kleborate_results |> 
  select(2, 13, 22, 36, 54, 62, 69, 74, 76:99, 101:104, 109:111, 115:117)

# Create merged genome metadata v1
genome_metadata_v1 <- assembly_stats_v2 |> 
  left_join(gfa_stats_v2, by = c("Genome" = "strain")) |>
  left_join(sra_metadata_v2, by = c("Genome" = "Sample_Name")) |>
  left_join(speciator_v2, by = c("Genome" = "Genome_Name")) |>
  left_join(lincodes_v2, by = c("Genome" = "Genome_Name")) |>
  left_join(kleborate_v2, by = c("Genome" = "Genome_Name")) |> 
  left_join(PP_clusters, by = c("Genome" = "Taxon")) |> 
  left_join(SNV_clusters, by = c("Genome" = "Genome", "Cluster" = "Cluster")) |> 
  rename(PopPUNK_cluster = Cluster) |> 
  relocate(81:82, 38:41, .after = Genome)
write_tsv(genome_metadata_v1, "Dataset/genome_metadata/genome_metadata_v1.tsv")

num_per_PPs <- genome_metadata_v1 |> 
  group_by(PopPUNK_cluster) |> 
  summarise(count = n())

# Combined mdata_v1 by adding assembly stats, sra metadata and Kleborate data
combined_mdata_v1 <- patient_metadata_v1 |> 
  # Join assembly stats
  left_join(genome_metadata_v1, by = c("Infecting_isolate" = "Genome")) |> 
  # QC col for genomes - contaminated...
  mutate(QC_status = case_when(
    Infecting_isolate %in% c("Y57", "307") ~ "Contaminated reads",
    TRUE ~ "Kept"
  ))

### Vis


ggsave(file=".png", plot=, width=12, height=5)

```

```{r Evaluating metrics and SHAP across each outcome prediction - OLD, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
### Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Prediction outcomes
Mortality_binary_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Mortality_binary_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Initial_treatment_failure_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Initial_treatment_failure_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Poor_prognosis_binary_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Poor_prognosis_binary_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Readmission_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Readmission_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Reinfection_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Reinfection_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Sepsis_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Sepsis_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)
Septic_shock_cv_metrics <- read_csv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/Septic_shock_cv_metrics.csv") |> 
  select(1:11)

### Manip

# Use ls() to find names matching the pattern
df_list_names <- ls(pattern = "_metrics$")

# Combine metrics together
combined_outcome_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(df_list_names, get)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(3:5, 10:11), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Metric_value") |> 
  mutate(Metric = case_when(
    Metric == "accuracy" ~ "Accuracy", 
    Metric == "auc" ~ "AUC", 
    Metric == "f1" ~ "F1", 
    Metric == "logloss" ~ "Log loss", 
    Metric == "crossentropy" ~ "Cross-entropy"
  )) |> 
  # Reorder factors manually
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Accuracy", "AUC", "F1", "Log loss", "Cross-entropy")))


### Vis
predictive_metrics_model_v1_boxplot <- ggplot(combined_outcome_metrics, aes(x = Metric, y = Metric_value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.25) + 
  labs(
    y = "Metric value"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  theme_bw()
predictive_metrics_model_v1_boxplot
ggsave(file="ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/predictive_metrics_model_v1_boxplot.png", plot=predictive_metrics_model_v1_boxplot, width=11, height=6)
```
