```{r Model training v1 SHAP values - OLD, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
### Load libraries

library(tidyverse)


### Load data

# SHAP values
cv_shap_Mortality <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Mortality_binary.tsv")
shap_Initial_treatment_failure <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Initial_treatment_failure.tsv")
shap_Poor_prognosis_binary <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Poor_prognosis_binary.tsv")
shap_Readmission <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Readmission.tsv")
shap_Reinfection <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Reinfection.tsv")
shap_Sepsis <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Sepsis.tsv")
shap_Septic_shock <- read_tsv("ML_predictions/model_v1_predictions/cv_shap_Septic_shock.tsv")

### Functions

mean_ranked_SHAP_func <- function(df) {
  df2 <- df |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(1:(last_col() - 1)), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP_value" ) |> 
    group_by(Feature) |>
    summarise(mean_absolute_SHAP = mean(abs(SHAP_value)))
}


### Manip dfs

# Get mean shap values
mean_SHAP_mortality <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(cv_shap_Mortality)
mean_SHAP_inital_treatment_failure <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Initial_treatment_failure)
mean_SHAP_readmission <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Readmission)
mean_SHAP_poor_prognosis <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Poor_prognosis_binary)
mean_SHAP_reinfection <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Reinfection)
mean_SHAP_sepsis <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Sepsis)
mean_SHAP_septic_shock <- mean_ranked_SHAP_func(shap_Septic_shock)



 # Plot decline
ggplot(mean_SHAP_mortality, aes(x = mean_absolute_SHAP)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.0001) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.02))
```

```{r Top 500 features from training round v1 - OLD, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

### Functions

# Funtion to obtain top 500 features from the top-ranked mean|SHAP| for each outcome
select_top_n_features_funct <- function(outcome_file) { 
  
  df <- read_tsv(
    paste0(
      "ML_predictions/output_v1/mean_abs_shap_",
      outcome_file,
      ".tsv"
    )
  ) |> 
    # Remove SHAP >0 cos no model influence
    filter(mean_abs_SHAP > 0) |> 
    # Take top 500 features based on mean_abs_SHAP
    slice_max(order_by = mean_abs_SHAP, n = 500) |> 
    # Determine if Clinical or Bacterial genomic based on patient metadata with a case_when call to the patient metadata cols, prior to merging before ML training
    mutate(
      Predicted_outcome = outcome_file,
      Feature_type = case_when(
        feature %in% colnames(combined_patient_mdata_v2) ~ "Clinical",
        TRUE ~ "Bacterial genomic"
      )
    )
  
  # Save these lists 
  write_lines(
    df$feature,
    paste0(
      "ML_predictions/ML_matrices/input_v2/",
      outcome_file,
      "_top_1k_features.txt"
    )
  )
  
  return(df)
}


# Load clinical metadata
combined_patient_mdata_v2 <- read_tsv(
  "Dataset/patient_metadata/combined_patient_mdata_v2.tsv"
)

# Get outcome names from SHAP files using list.files and pattern
list_mean_abs_SHAP_files <- list.files(
  "ML_predictions/output_v1",
  pattern = "^mean_abs_shap_.*\\.tsv$"
) |>
  str_remove("^mean_abs_shap_") |>
  str_remove("\\.tsv$")

# Run function across all predicted outcomes by parsing the list with map()
# map() applies function to each element of a list or atomic vector
top_feature_dfs <- map(
  list_mean_abs_SHAP_files,
  select_top_n_features_funct
  )

# Write the table to a merged tibble
top_500_features_SHAP_outcome <- top_feature_dfs |> 
  bind_rows()
write_tsv(top_500_features_SHAP_outcome, "ML_predictions/output_v1/top_500_features_SHAP_outcome.tsv")

count_feature_type_SHAP <- top_500_features_SHAP_outcome |> 
  group_by(Predicted_outcome, Feature_type) |> 
  summarise(
    num_per_type = n()
  ) |> 
  mutate(Proportion = num_per_type / 500)


  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("AUC", "Accuracy", "F1-score", "Log loss", "Cross-entropy"))) |>
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Mortality", "Poor prognosis", "Septic shock", "Sepsis", "Respiratory support", "Vasoactive use", "Initial treatment failure", "Readmission", "Reinfection")))

```

```{r plotting test of plasmid maps, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Custom plotting function
plot_plasmid_all_labels <- function(
  dat,
  bp,
  name = "Plasmid Name",
  rotation = 0,
  label_wrap = 20
) {

  dat <- dat[dat$type != "source", ]

  name_supplied <- !is.null(name) && name != ""
  yintercept <- if (name_supplied) 4 else 0

  plt <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    dat,
    ggplot2::aes(
      start = start,
      end = end,
      direction = direction,
      fill = type,
      group = index
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = yintercept) +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(start = rotation) +

    ## ---- FIXED LABELS ----
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = (start + end) / 2,
      y = yintercept,
      label = stringr::str_wrap(name, label_wrap)
    ),
    box.padding = 0.6,
    size = 3,
    segment.curvature = 0.01,
    label.r = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
    stat_arrow(
      colour = "black",
      bp = bp,
      arrowhead_size = 1
    ) +

    ggfittext::geom_fit_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = name,
        y = yintercept
      ),
      stat = "arrowLabel",
      grow = FALSE,
      size = 10,
      min.size = 1
    ) +

    ggplot2::ylim(c(yintercept - 4, NA)) +
    ggplot2::xlim(c(0, bp)) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 5) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

  if (name_supplied) {
    plt <- plt +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        label = stringr::str_glue("{name}\n{bp} bp")
      )
  }

  plt
}
```
